title: Spring 2.5 Aspect Oriented Programming
description:
Spring 2.5 Aspect Oriented Programming introduces developers to the incredible advantages of combining the Spring framework with Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP) principles. By blending modular and clean code with cross-cutting concerns like security and transactions, this book empowers developers to write robust and scalable enterprise applications.

What this Book will help me do

Understand and apply the principles of Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP) to modularize code effectively.
Learn to configure and utilize Spring AOP for developing scalable enterprise-grade applications.
Master techniques for enhancing application functionality with security, logging, and transaction management using AOP.
Implement advanced Spring features such as AspectJ annotations for defining cross-cutting concerns.
Build a complete multi-layered web application employing Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) principles.

Author(s)

The authors are experienced software engineers specializing in Java enterprise applications and the Spring framework. They bring their expertise in best practices and advanced programming concepts to help developers improve application structure and functionality. Their detailed yet accessible approach ensures learners of all levels find value.

Who is it for?

This book is aimed at Java developers and architects familiar with basic Spring concepts who want to learn how to enhance their applications with modular and efficient code using AOP. Readers will gain the skills needed to manage cross-cutting concerns with solid examples and practical implementation advice. If you're focused on writing effective and maintainable Java applications, this book is for you.
translatedDescription:
Spring 2.5 Aspect Oriented Programming presenta a los desarrolladores las increíbles ventajas de combinar el marco de primavera con los principios de Programación Aspect-Oriented (AOP). Al combinar código modular y limpio con preocupaciones intersectoriales como la seguridad y las transacciones, este libro permite a los desarrolladores escribir aplicaciones empresariales robustas y escalables.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprender y aplicar los principios de la programación orientada al respeto (AOP) para modular el código de manera efectiva.
Aprende a configurar y utilizar Spring AOP para desarrollar aplicaciones de nivel empresarial escalables.
Técnicas maestras para mejorar la funcionalidad de aplicación con seguridad, registro y gestión de transacciones utilizando AOP.
Implementar funciones avanzadas de primavera como las anotaciones de AspectJ para definir preocupaciones intersectoriales.
Construir una aplicación web multicapa completa empleando los principios de Domain-Driven Design (DDD) y Test-Driven Development (TDD).

Autor(s)

Los autores son experimentados ingenieros de software especializados en aplicaciones empresariales Java y el marco de Primavera. Llevan su experiencia en mejores prácticas y conceptos de programación avanzados para ayudar a los desarrolladores a mejorar la estructura de aplicaciones y la funcionalidad. Su enfoque detallado y accesible garantiza que los estudiantes de todos los niveles encuentren valor.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro está dirigido a desarrolladores y arquitectos Java familiarizados con conceptos básicos de primavera que quieren aprender a mejorar sus aplicaciones con código modular y eficiente utilizando AOP. Los lectores obtendrán las habilidades necesarias para gestionar las preocupaciones intersectoriales con ejemplos sólidos y consejos prácticos de implementación. Si estás enfocado en escribir aplicaciones Java eficaces y sostenibles, este libro es para ti.

They bring years of experience in using Jupyter for professional tasks and teaching its use to others. Who is it for?

This book is ideal for data scientists, machine learning practitioners, software developers, and those engaged in collaborative technical projects. It's designed for individuals who have a basic programming knowledge and want to learn how to harness Jupyter for advanced data processing and visualization. Whether you're tackling a complex analysis or creating educational material, this book is your guide to mastering Jupyter.

title: Advanced JAVA Networking
description:
Super-charged network solutions for experienced Java professionals, updated to Java 2

Create powerful client/server applications with RMI

Use IDL to build CORBA applications that work with legacy systems

Interface with databases using JDBC and SQL

Completely updated from the best-selling first edition

The latest in Java: JDBC, JINI, JMAPI, IDL, and CORBA

Up-to-date networking: TCP/IP, RMI, sockets

Application servers, Web servers, and servlets

Directory Services, LDAP, and JNDI

Advances in Java security

Java remains the language of choice for building Internet and networked applications. In this completely updated second edition of the 1997 best seller, Dick Steflik and Prashant Sridharan bring you tips on the hottest new developments in Java and its family of technologies. For seasoned programmers who need to stay current on Java for network applications, this is the book with the answers.

Java is the first programming language created with the Internet in mind, and this book shows you how it optimizes networked applications with such architectural elements as multithreading, serialization, and I/O. Step-by-step implementations take you through the creation of Java solutions for client/server and Internet environments, using the latest releases of each API. Advanced Java Networking, Second Edition gives you the newest techniques to use with:

Servlets for dynamic Web content

JavaBeans to create plug-and-play software components

JMAPI for centralized management of Java objects

If you are a manager considering networked Java applications, you will find everything you need to understand the scope and possibilities of the project. If you are a professional Java software developer or engineer, you can't afford to miss the essential resources in Advanced Java Networking, Second Edition.

About the CD-ROM

Free CD is packed with live sample code to get you up to speed fast.

Apply troubleshooting techniques and best practices for enterprise-level microservice architecture.

title: Pivotal Certified Spring Enterprise Integration Specialist Exam
description:
Exam topics covered include tasks and scheduling, remoting, the Spring Web Services framework, RESTful services with Spring MVC, the Spring JMS module, JMS and JTA transactions with Spring, batch processing with Spring Batch and the Spring Integration framework. Prepare with confidence for the Pivotal Enterprise Integration with Spring Exam.

One of the important aspects of this book is a focus on new and modern abstractions provided by Spring. Therefore most of the features are shown with Java annotations alongside established XML configurations. Most of the examples in the book are also based on the Spring Boot framework. Spring Boot adoption is exponential because of its capability to significantly simplify Spring configuration using sensible opinionated defaults. But Spring Boot is not the target of the exam, therefore all the features are also covered with plain Spring configuration examples.

Los temas de examen abarcan tareas y programación, remoción, el marco de Servicios Web de Primavera, servicios RESTful con Spring MVC, el módulo de Spring JMS, JMS y JTA transacciones con Spring, procesamiento por lotes con Spring Batch y el marco de Integración de Primavera. Prepárate con confianza para la integración de la empresa con el examen de primavera.

Uno de los aspectos importantes de este libro es centrarse en las abstracciones nuevas y modernas proporcionadas por la primavera. Por lo tanto, la mayoría de las características se muestran con anotaciones Java junto con configuraciones XML establecidas. La mayoría de los ejemplos en el libro también se basan en el marco de arranque de primavera. La adopción de Spring Boot es exponencial debido a su capacidad para simplificar significativamente la configuración de Primavera utilizando predeterminados de opinión razonables. Pero Spring Boot no es el objetivo del examen, por lo tanto todas las características también están cubiertas con simples ejemplos de configuración de Primavera.

title: React: Building Modern Web Applications
description:
Master the art of building dynamic, modern web applications with React

About This Book

Learn the hot new frontend web framework from Facebook ? ReactJS, an easy way of developing the V in MVC and a better approach to software engineering in JavaScript
A fast-paced guide to designing and building scalable and maintainable web apps with React.js
Learn all the new ES6 features and be among the most prominent JavaScript developers who can write efficient JS programs as per the latest standards
Master the art of building modern web applications using React
Learn to build modern native iOS and Android applications using JavaScript and the incredible power of React

Who This Book Is For

This course is for web developers that want to unlock high performance dynamism in the applications that they create. If you want a comprehensive journey into one of the most important JavaScript frameworks around today, dive into this course.

What You Will Learn

Take control of the front end with reactive JavaScript programming
Discover what ReactJS offers your development - before mastering it
Create React elements with properties and children
Use JSX to speed up your React development process
Test your React components with the Jest test framework
Learn the latest syntax of ES6
Execute ES6 in a non-supported ES6 environment
Learn the principles of object-oriented programming
Create a complete single-page application
Use an application design plan to write smarter, more meaningful code
Learn how to use animations to give extra style to your application
Get to grips with the React Native environment
Write your own custom native UI components
Integrate native modules in Objective-C and Java that interact with JavaScript

In Detail

ReactJS has helped to transform the web as we know it. Designed by Facebook to help developers build rapid, responsive UI that can deal with data-intensive usage, it's an essential component in any web developer's skillset. This ReactJS course, in five connected modules, provides you with a fast, engaging and practical route into ReactJS - so you can build powerful, elegant, and modern web applications.

Beginning with the Reactive Programming with JavaScript module, you will learn how to take advantage of a reactive and functional programming paradigm to rethink how you approach your JavaScript code. It's built to help you understand the concepts, relevant and applicable for any frontend developer.

You'll then dive a little deeper into ReactJS. The second module gives you a rapid look through the fundamentals of ReactJS, showing you how to build a basic application and demonstrating how to implement the Flux architecture.

In the third module you will get to grips with ES6 - this will make you a more fluent JavaScript developer, giving you control over ReactJS. You can put your old JavaScript hacks aside and instead explore how to create ES6 custom iterators.

In the final two modules you'll learn how to fully master ReactJS, exploring its wider ecosystem of tools that have helped to make it one of the most important tools in web development today. Ending with insights and guidance on React Native, the tool built for today's demand for native, intuitive user experiences and interfaces, with this course you can be confident in building dynamic and modern apps with React.

Style and approach

Consisting of five separate modules, journey from the fundamentals of reactive programming to the exciting possibilities of React Native. Each module builds on each other, helping you to incrementally develop your skills and knowledge.

Master el arte de construir aplicaciones web dinámicas y modernas con React

Acerca de este libro

Aprende el nuevo marco web de frontend caliente de Facebook ? ReactJS, una manera fácil de desarrollar la V en MVC y un mejor enfoque de ingeniería de software en JavaScript
Una guía de ritmo rápido para diseñar y construir aplicaciones web escalables y sostenibles con React.js
Conozca todas las nuevas características de ES6 y sea uno de los desarrolladores de JavaScript más destacados que pueden escribir programas de JS eficientes según los últimos estándares
Master el arte de construir aplicaciones web modernas utilizando React
Aprende a construir aplicaciones nativas modernas iOS y Android usando JavaScript y el increíble poder de React

Quién es este libro

Este curso es para desarrolladores web que quieren desbloquear el dinamismo de alto rendimiento en las aplicaciones que crean. Si quieres un viaje completo en uno de los marcos JavaScript más importantes de hoy, bucea en este curso.

Qué aprenderás

Tome el control de la parte frontal con programación reactiva de JavaScript
Descubra lo que ReactJS ofrece su desarrollo - antes de dominarlo
Crear elementos de reacción con propiedades y niños
Utilice JSX para acelerar su proceso de desarrollo de React
Pruebe sus componentes React con el marco de prueba Jest
Aprende la última sintaxis de ES6
Ejecute ES6 en un entorno ES6 no compatible
Aprenda los principios de programación orientada al objeto
Crear una aplicación completa de una sola página
Utilice un plan de diseño de aplicaciones para escribir código más inteligente, más significativo
Aprende a usar animaciones para dar estilo extra a tu aplicación
Ponte en contacto con el entorno nativo de React
Escribe tus propios componentes UI nativos personalizados
Integrar módulos nativos en Objective-C y Java que interactúan con JavaScript

En detalle

ReactJS ha ayudado a transformar la web tal como lo conocemos. Diseñado por Facebook para ayudar a los desarrolladores a construir una interfaz de usuario rápida y receptiva que pueda lidiar con el uso intensivo de datos, es un componente esencial en el destreza de cualquier desarrollador web. Este curso ReactJS, en cinco módulos conectados, le proporciona una ruta rápida, atractiva y práctica en ReactJS - para que pueda construir aplicaciones web potentes, elegantes y modernas.

Empezando con el módulo Programación Reactiva con JavaScript, aprenderás a aprovechar un paradigma de programación reactivo y funcional para repensar cómo abordas tu código JavaScript. Está construido para ayudarle a entender los conceptos, relevantes y aplicables para cualquier desarrollador de frontend.

Luego te sumergirás un poco más en ReactJS. El segundo módulo le da una mirada rápida a través de los fundamentos de ReactJS, mostrándole cómo construir una aplicación básica y demostrando cómo implementar la arquitectura Flux.

En el tercer módulo se puede conectar con ES6 - esto le hará un desarrollador de JavaScript más fluido, dándole control sobre ReactJS. Puede dejar a un lado sus antiguos hacks JavaScript y en su lugar explorar cómo crear iterators personalizados ES6.

En los dos módulos finales aprenderás a dominar completamente ReactJS, explorando su ecosistema más amplio de herramientas que han ayudado a convertirlo en una de las herramientas más importantes en el desarrollo web de hoy. Terminando con información y orientación sobre React Native, la herramienta construida para la demanda de hoy en día de experiencias e interfaces de usuario nativas, intuitivas, con este curso puedes confiar en construir aplicaciones dinámicas y modernas con React.

Estilo y enfoque

Consisting of five separate modules, journey from the fundamentals of reactive programming to the exciting possibilities of React Native. Cada módulo se construye entre sí, ayudándole a desarrollar gradualmente sus habilidades y conocimientos.

title: Oracle Database Programming using Java and Web Services
description: The traditional division of labor between the database (which only stores and manages SQL and XML data for fast, easy data search and retrieval) and the application server (which runs application or business logic, and presentation logic) is obsolete. Although the books primary focus is on programming the Oracle Database, the concepts and techniques provided apply to most RDBMS that support Java including Oracle, DB2, Sybase, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. This is the first book to cover new Java, JDBC, SQLJ, JPublisher and Web Services features in Oracle Database 10g Release 2 (the coverage starts with Oracle 9i Release 2). This book is a must-read for database developers audience (DBAs, database applications developers, data architects), Java developers (JDBC, SQLJ, J2EE, and OR Mapping frameworks), and to the emerging Web Services assemblers.* Describes pragmatic solutions, advanced database applications, as well as provision of a wealth of code samples * Addresses programming models which run within the database as well as programming models which run in middle-tier or client-tier against the database.* Discusses languages for stored procedures: when to use proprietary languages such as PL/SQL and when to use standard languages such as Java; also running non-Java scripting languages in the database* Describes the Java runtime in the Oracle database 10g (i.e., OracleJVM), its architecture, memory management, security management, threading, Java execution, the Native Compiler (i.e., NCOMP), how to make Java known to SQL and PL/SQL, data types mapping, how to call-out to external Web components, EJB components, ERP frameworks, and external databases.* Describes JDBC programming and the new Oracle JDBC 10g features, its advanced connection services (pooling, failover, load-balancing, and the fast database event notification mechanism) for clustered databases (RAC) in Grid environments.* Describes SQLJ programming and the latest Oracle SQLJ 10g features , contrasting it with JDBC * Describes the latest Database Web services features, Web services concepts and Services Oriented Architecture (SOA) for DBA, the database as Web services provider and the database as Web services consumer.* Abridged coverage of JPublisher 10g, a versatile complement to JDBC, SQLJ and Database Web Services.
translatedDescription: La división tradicional del trabajo entre la base de datos (que sólo almacena y administra datos SQL y XML para la búsqueda y recuperación de datos rápidos y fáciles) y el servidor de aplicaciones (que funciona la lógica de aplicación o de negocio, y la lógica de presentación) es obsoleta. Aunque el objetivo principal de los libros es la programación de la base de datos Oracle, los conceptos y técnicas proporcionados se aplican a la mayoría de RDBMS que apoyan Java incluyendo Oracle, DB2, Sybase, MySQL y PostgreSQL. Este es el primer libro que cubre las nuevas funciones Java, JDBC, SQLJ, JPublisher y Web Services en Oracle Database 10g Release 2 (la cobertura comienza con Oracle 9i Release 2). Este libro es imprescindible para el público desarrollador de bases de datos (DBAs, desarrolladores de aplicaciones de bases de datos, arquitectos de datos), desarrolladores de Java (JDBC, SQLJ, J2EE y OR Mapping frameworks), y para los ensambladores emergentes de Servicios Web*. Describe soluciones pragmáticas, aplicaciones avanzadas de bases de datos, así como la provisión de una gran cantidad de muestras de código * Dirige modelos de programación que se ejecutan dentro de la base de datos, así como modelos de programación que se ejecutan en nivel medio o nivel cliente contra la base de datos*. Discusses languages for stored procedures: when to use proprietary languages such as PL/SQL and when to use standard languages such as Java; also running non-Java scripting languages in the database* Describe el tiempo de ejecución Java en la base de datos Oracle 10g (es decir, OracleJVM), su arquitectura, gestión de memoria, gestión de seguridad, rosca, ejecución Java, el Compilador Nativo (es decir, NCOMP), cómo hacer que Java sea conocido por SQL y PL/SQL, mapeo de tipos de datos, cómo llamar a los componentes Web externos, componentes EJB, marcos ERP y bases de datos externas*. Describe la programación JDBC y las nuevas funciones de Oracle JDBC 10g, sus servicios avanzados de conexión (conjunción, failover, balance de carga y el mecanismo de notificación rápida de eventos de base de datos) para bases de datos agrupadas (RAC) en entornos Grid.* Describe la programación SQLJ y las últimas funciones de Oracle SQLJ 10g, contrastándola con JDBC * Describe las últimas funciones de servicios web de Base de Datos, conceptos de servicios web y arquitectura orientada a servicios (SOA) para DBA, la base de datos como proveedor de servicios web y la base de datos como consumidor de servicios web.* Cobertura reducida de JPublisher 10g, un complemento versátil de JDBC, SQLJ y Database Web Services.

title: The Java® Tutorial: A Short Course on the Basics, Fifth Edition
description: The Java®Tutorial, Fifth Edition, is based on Release 7 of the Java Platform Standard Edition. This revised and updated edition introduces the new features added to the platform, including a section on NIO.2, the new file I/O API, and information on migrating legacy code to the new API. The deployment coverage has also been expanded, with new chapters such as “Doing More with Rich Internet Applications” and “Deployment in Depth,” and a section on the fork/join feature has been added to the chapter on concurrency. Information reflecting Project Coin developments, including the new try-with-resources statement, the ability to catch more than one type of exception with a single exception handler, support for binary literals, and diamond syntax, which results in cleaner generics code, has been added where appropriate. The chapters covering generics, Java Web Start, and applets have also been updated. In addition, if you plan to take one of the Java SE 7 certification exams, this guide can help. A special appendix, “Preparing for Java Programming Language Certification,” lists the three exams available, details the items covered on each exam, and provides cross-references to where more information about each topic appears in the text. All of the material has been thoroughly reviewed by members of Oracle Java engineering to ensure that the information is accurate and up to date.

La cobertura de despliegue también se ha ampliado, con nuevos capítulos como “Hacer más con aplicaciones de Internet ricas” y “Deployment in Depth”, y una sección sobre la función de tenedor/junción se ha añadido al capítulo sobre la concurrencia. Información que refleja los desarrollos del Proyecto Coin, incluyendo la nueva declaración de prueba con recursos, la capacidad de capturar más de un tipo de excepción con un manejador de una sola excepción, soporte para literales binarios, y sintaxis de diamante, que resulta en código genéricos más limpios, se ha añadido cuando proceda. title: Object-Oriented Data Structures Using Java, 3rd Edition
description:
Continuing the success of the popular second edition, the updated and revised Object-Oriented Data Structures Using Java, Third Edition is sure to be an essential resource for students learning data structures using the Java programming language. It presents traditional data structures and object-oriented topics with an emphasis on problem-solving, theory, and software engineering principles. Beginning early and continuing throughout the text, the authors introduce and expand upon the use of many Java features including packages, interfaces, abstract classes, inheritance, and exceptions. Numerous case studies provide readers with real-world examples and demonstrate possible solutions to interesting problems. The authors' lucid writing style guides readers through the rigor of standard data structures and presents essential concepts from logical, applications, and implementation levels. Key concepts throughout the Third Edition have been clarified to increase student comprehension and retention, and end-of-chapter exercises have been updated and modified.

New and Key Features to the Third Edition:

-Includes the use of generics throughout the text, providing the dual benefits of allowing for a type safe use of data structures plus exposing students to modern approaches.-This text is among the first data structures textbooks to address the topic of concurrency and synchonization, which are growing in the importance as computer systems move to using more cores and threads to obtain additional performance with each new generation. Concurrency and synchonization are introduced in the new Section 5.7, where it begins with the basics of Java threads.-Provides numerous case studies and examples of the problem solving process. Each case study includes problem description, an analysis of the problem input and required output, and a discussion of the appropriate data structures to use.-Expanded chapter exercises allow you as the instructor to reinforce topics for your students using both theoretical and practical questions.-Chapters conclude with a chapter summary that highlights the most important topics of the chapter and ties together related topics.

Instructor Resources:-Answers to the exercises in the text-Glossary of terms-PowerPoint Lecture Outlines-Test bank

title: Jakarta Struts Cookbook

title: Vue.js 2 Design Patterns and Best Practices
description:
Vue.js 2 Design Patterns and Best Practices is your practical guide to mastering modern application development with Vue.js. Through this detailed book, you'll explore how to write clean, reusable, and modular code using Vue.js components and leverage state management with Vuex. Additionally, you'll cover routing with Vue Router and optimize for performance using Nuxt and other industry-standard tools.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the core principles and patterns of Vue.js and how to use them in application development.
Design scalable and modular applications with advanced Vue.js practices.
Implement state management solutions using Vuex to enhance application reactivity.
Develop single-page applications and ensure smooth navigation using Vue Router.
Utilize Nuxt for server-side rendering and improve application performance while ensuring best practices are followed.

Author(s)

The author None Halliday is an experienced JavaScript developer with a deep passion for Vue.js and front-end architectures. Through years of professional practice, they have honed skills in crafting highly scalable and maintainable applications. This book reflects the author's commitment to teaching through clarity and practical examples, enriching developers' understanding.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for experienced JavaScript developers who are already familiar with the basics of Vue.js and are eager to deepen their knowledge of design patterns and best practices to build robust and professional Vue.js applications. If you want to enhance your expertise and expand your proficiency in creating scalable single-page applications (SPAs) with Vuex and Nuxt, this book is for you.
translatedDescription:
Vue.js 2 Patrones de diseño y mejores prácticas es su guía práctica para dominar el desarrollo de aplicaciones modernas con Vue.js. A través de este libro detallado, explorarás cómo escribir códigos limpios, reutilizables y modulares usando componentes Vue.js y la gestión estatal de apalancamiento con Vuex. Además, cubrirás el enrutamiento con Vue Router y optimizarás el rendimiento utilizando Nuxt y otras herramientas estándar de la industria.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Entender los principios y patrones básicos de Vue.js y cómo utilizarlos en el desarrollo de aplicaciones.
Diseño de aplicaciones escalables y modulares con prácticas avanzadas Vue.js.
Implementar soluciones de gestión estatal utilizando Vuex para mejorar la reactividad de aplicaciones.
Desarrollar aplicaciones de una sola página y asegurar la navegación suave utilizando Vue Router.
Utilizar Nuxt para renderizar y mejorar el rendimiento de aplicaciones al mismo tiempo que se garantizan mejores prácticas.

Autor(s)

El autor Ninguno Halliday es un desarrollador de JavaScript experimentado con una profunda pasión por Vue.js y arquitecturas de vanguardia. A través de años de práctica profesional, han perfeccionado habilidades en la elaboración de aplicaciones altamente escalables y sostenibles. Este libro refleja el compromiso del autor de enseñar con claridad y ejemplos prácticos, enriquecendo la comprensión de los desarrolladores.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para desarrolladores de JavaScript experimentados que ya están familiarizados con los fundamentos de Vue.js y están deseosos de profundizar su conocimiento de patrones de diseño y mejores prácticas para construir aplicaciones Vue.js robustas y profesionales. Si desea mejorar su experiencia y ampliar su competencia en la creación de aplicaciones escalables de una sola página (SPAs) con Vuex y Nuxt, este libro es para usted.

title: More Servlets and JavaServer Pages™
description:
Companion to the worldwide bestseller Core Servlets and JavaServer Pages

Practical guide to the use of the Java Platform for Web-enabled applications and dynamic Web sites

Focus on new capabilities: the servlet 2.3 and JSP 1.2 specifications, the standard JSP tag library (JSPTL), filters, life-cycle event listeners, security, Web applications, and much more

Configuration and usage details for Apache Tomcat, Macromedia JRun, and New Atlanta ServletExec

The Java 2 Platform has become the technology of choice for developing professional e-commerce applications, dynamic Web pages, and Web-enabled applications and services. Servlet and JSP technology is the foundation of this platform: it provides the link between Web clients and server-side applications. But, the field has been evolving rapidly, and few developers have been able to keep up. In this companion to Core Servlets and JavaServer Pages, Marty Hall shows you how to apply recent advances in servlet and JSP technology. The book provides everything you need to know to leverage the latest servlet 2.3 and JSP 1.2 standards: real-world insight, advanced techniques, industrial-strength code, and hands on coverage of three top servers: Apache Tomcat, Macromedia JRun, and New Atlanta ServletExec.

Part I gives a thorough introduction to programming with servlet and JSP technology. It shows you how to configure your server, read form data and HTTP headers, handle cookies, track sessions, apply JSP scripting elements, use JavaBeans components, develop JSP tag libraries, and apply the MVC architecture.

Part II provides exhaustive details on Web application development and deployment. It explains how to register Web applications, how to organize them, how to deploy them in WAR files, how to deal with relative URLs, and how to share data among Web applications. It also gives details on every element in version 2.3 of the deployment descriptor (web.xml).

Part III describes Web application security in detail. It explains two general strategies for securing your applications: declarative security and programmatic security. Within each of these strategies, it shows you how to use form-based or BASIC authentication and how to protect your network traffic with SSL.

Part IV covers two features introduced with servlets 2.3: filters and life-cycle events. It explains how to use filters to debug, modify, and optimize the output of previously existing servlets and JSP pages. It also shows you how to use event listeners to respond to major events in the server life cycle.

Part V looks at new tag library developments. It shows you how to improve your own tag libraries by making use of new capabilities of the JSP 1.2 specification and explains how to streamline your code by using the new standard JSP tag library (JSPTL).

More Servlets and JavaServer Pages delivers:

The same clear, step-by-step explanations that make Marty's books so popular

In-depth, hands-on coverage of the latest standards: servlets 2.3 and JSP 1.2

Hundreds of completely portable, fully documented, industrial-strength examples

On-line access to all source code, available free for unrestricted use
translatedDescription:
Compañero con el bestseller Core Servlets y JavaServer Pages

Guía práctica para el uso de la Plataforma Java para aplicaciones Web habilitadas y sitios Web dinámicos

Centrarse en nuevas capacidades: las especificaciones Servlet 2.3 y JSP 1.2, la biblioteca de etiquetas JSP estándar (JSPTL), filtros, oyentes de eventos de ciclo de vida, seguridad, aplicaciones web, y mucho más

Detalles de configuración y uso para Apache Tomcat, Macromedia JRun y New Atlanta ServletExec

La plataforma Java 2 se ha convertido en la tecnología de elección para desarrollar aplicaciones profesionales de comercio electrónico, páginas web dinámicas y aplicaciones y servicios habilitados en la Web. La tecnología Servlet y JSP es la base de esta plataforma: proporciona el enlace entre los clientes Web y las aplicaciones lado servidor. Pero el campo ha evolucionado rápidamente, y pocos desarrolladores han sido capaces de mantenerse al día. En este compañero de Core Servlets y JavaServer Pages, Marty Hall le muestra cómo aplicar avances recientes en la tecnología servlet y JSP. El libro proporciona todo lo que necesita saber para aprovechar los últimos estándares de servlet 2.3 y JSP 1.2: conocimiento del mundo real, técnicas avanzadas, código de fuerza industrial y manos en la cobertura de tres servidores principales: Apache Tomcat, Macromedia JRun y New Atlanta ServletExec.

La parte I da una introducción exhaustiva a la programación con la tecnología servlet y JSP. Le muestra cómo configurar su servidor, leer datos de formularios y encabezados HTTP, manejar cookies, sesiones de seguimiento, aplicar elementos de scripting JSP, utilizar componentes JavaBeans, desarrollar bibliotecas de etiquetas JSP y aplicar la arquitectura MVC.

La parte II proporciona detalles exhaustivos sobre el desarrollo y el despliegue de aplicaciones en la Web. Explica cómo registrar aplicaciones web, cómo organizarlas, cómo implementarlas en archivos WAR, cómo tratar las URL relativas y cómo compartir datos entre aplicaciones web. También da detalles sobre cada elemento en la versión 2.3 del descriptor de despliegue (web.xml).

En la parte III se describe detalladamente la seguridad de la aplicación web. Explica dos estrategias generales para asegurar sus aplicaciones: seguridad declarativa y seguridad programática. Dentro de cada una de estas estrategias, le muestra cómo utilizar la autenticación basada en forma o BASIC y cómo proteger su tráfico de red con SSL.

La parte IV cubre dos características introducidas con servlets 2.3: filtros y eventos de ciclo de vida. Explica cómo utilizar filtros para depurar, modificar y optimizar la salida de servlets previamente existentes y páginas JSP. También le muestra cómo utilizar los oyentes de eventos para responder a eventos importantes en el ciclo de vida del servidor.

La parte V mira nuevos desarrollos de la biblioteca de etiquetas. Le muestra cómo mejorar sus propias bibliotecas de etiquetas haciendo uso de nuevas capacidades de la especificación JSP 1.2 y explica cómo simplificar su código utilizando la nueva biblioteca de etiquetas JSP estándar (JSPTL).

Más Servlets y JavaServer Pages ofrece:

Las mismas explicaciones claras, paso a paso que hacen los libros de Marty tan popular

Cobertura detallada y práctica de los últimos estándares: servlets 2.3 y JSP 1.2

Cientos de ejemplos completamente portátiles, completamente documentados, de fuerza industrial

Acceso en línea a todo el código fuente, disponible gratuitamente para uso sin restricciones

title: Pro JavaFX 8
description:
In Pro JavaFX 8 expert authors show you how to use the JavaFX platform to create rich-client Java applications. You'll discover how you can use this powerful Java-based UI platform, which is capable of handling large-scale data-driven business applications for PC as well as now mobile and embedded devices.

Covering the JavaFX API, development tools, and best practices, this book provides code examples that explore the exciting new features provided with JavaFX 8 which comes as part of Oracle's new Java (SE) 8 release. This book also contains engaging tutorials that cover virtually every facet of JavaFX development and reference materials on JavaFX that augment the JavaFX API documentation.

After reading and using this book, you'll have the authoritative knowledge that should give you an edge in your next JavaFX-based application projects for your job or your clients.

title: Sams Teach Yourself J2EE™ in 21 Days, Second Edition
description:
J2EE has become required knowledge for any serious Java developer, but learning this large and complex specification requires a substantial investment of time and energy. Sams Teach Yourself J2EE in 21 Days, 2/E presents the enterprise Java architecture in accessible, easy-to-comprehend lessons, describing how each J2EE tool solves the challenges of n-Tier development. Using the architecture as a roadmap, chapters describe Enterprise JavaBeans (EJB), JavaServer Pages (JSP), Java Servlets, and more, giving readers a full understanding of J2EE development.

Further chapters cover the role of XML, custom JSP tags, creating J2EE Web Services, and how Java Connectors allow J2EE applications to interact with legacy and non-Java systems. The book finishes with sample applications which put all the pieces together, including an example using J2EE to create Web Services. Along the way, every concept is illustrated with practical, real-world examples to ensure understanding by Java students as well as experts.

Utilizando la arquitectura como hoja de ruta, capítulos describen Enterprise JavaBeans (EJB), JavaServer Pages (JSP), Java Servlets, y más, dando a los lectores una comprensión completa del desarrollo J2EE.

title: VMware vSphere 5.x Datacenter Design Cookbook
description:
The "VMware vSphere 5.x Datacenter Design Cookbook" is a comprehensive guide to mastering the design of a VMware-based virtual datacenter. Through a recipe-driven approach, this book walks readers through identifying requirements, planning designs, and successfully implementing VMware vSphere solutions. Ideal for IT professionals, this practical guide focuses on real-world applications and best practices in virtual datacenter design.

What this Book will help me do

Learn to identify key factors influencing VMware vSphere designs and apply them effectively.
Understand how to create a conceptual design based on business and technical requirements.
Design systems with performance, availability, recoverability, manageability, and security in mind.
Translate logical resource designs into detailed and actionable physical infrastructure designs.
Produce high-quality professional VMware design documentation for implementation success.

Author(s)

Hersey Cartwright is a seasoned IT professional and VMware expert with years of experience in designing and managing virtual environments. He brings a wealth of practical knowledge and a clear teaching style that helps both beginners and advanced VMware users alike. His experience as an author and educator is evident in the book's concise and actionable format. Hersey's approach focuses on practical skills and real-world examples, making complex topics accessible to all.

Who is it for?

This book is targeted at IT professionals, system administrators, and engineers who are looking to expand their skills in VMware vSphere design and management. It is ideal for readers with some basic understanding of virtualization concepts but aims to provide guidance for mastering advanced design principles. Whether you're aiming to enhance an existing skill set or design a virtual datacenter for the first time, this book will empower you to achieve your professional goals. Step-by-step exercises and best practices ensure accessible yet thorough learning.

title: Continuous Emission Monitoring, 3rd Edition
description:
CONTINUOUS EMISSION MONITORING

The new edition of the only single-volume reference on both the regulatory and technical aspects of U.S. and international continuous emission monitoring (CEM) systems

Continuous Emission Monitoring presents clear, accurate, and up-to-date information on the technical and regulatory issues that affect the design, application, and certification of CEM systems installed in power plants, cement plants, pulp and paper mills, smelters, and other stationary sources. Written by an international expert in the field, this classic reference guide covers U.S. and international CEM regulatory requirements, analytical techniques, operation and maintenance of CEM instrumentation, and more.

The fully revised Third Edition remains the most comprehensive source of CEM information available, featuring three brand-new chapters on mercury monitoring, the reporting and ­certification of industrial greenhouse gas emissions, and the instrumentation and methods used to measure air toxic compounds including dioxins, furans, and hydrogen chloride. Thoroughly updated chapters discuss topics such as flow rate monitors, new EPA regulations, instrumentation and calibration techniques, CEM system control and data acquisition, and extractive system design. Providing environmental professionals with the knowledge of CEM systems necessary to address the present-day regulatory environment, Continuous Emission Monitoring:

Discusses how CEM systems work, their advantages and limitations, and the regulatory requirements governing their operation
Covers both the historical framework and technological basis of current CEM regulatory programs and standards in the United States, Canada, Europe, and Asia
Offers practical guidance on sampling system selection, measurement techniques, advanced monitoring approaches, recordkeeping, and quality assurance
Provides detailed technical descriptions of the technology necessary for regulatory compliance
Includes new orthographic drawings to help instrument technicians and regulators with little technical background to easily understand key topics

Continuous Emission Monitoring, Third Edition is an essential resource for professionals responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance, managers and technicians who purchase, operate, and maintain CEM instrumentation, regulatory personnel who write and enforce operating permits, and instructors and students in upper-level environmental engineering programs.

title: Virtualization for Security
description: One of the biggest buzzwords in the IT industry for the past few years, virtualization has matured into a practical requirement for many best-practice business scenarios, becoming an invaluable tool for security professionals at companies of every size. In addition to saving time and other resources, virtualization affords unprecedented means for intrusion and malware detection, prevention, recovery, and analysis. Taking a practical approach in a growing market underserved by books, this hands-on title is the first to combine in one place the most important and sought-after uses of virtualization for enhanced security, including sandboxing, disaster recovery and high availability, forensic analysis, and honeypotting.Already gaining buzz and traction in actual usage at an impressive rate, Gartner research indicates that virtualization will be the most significant trend in IT infrastructure and operations over the next four years. A recent report by IT research firm IDC predicts the virtualization services market will grow from $5.5 billion in 2006 to $11.7 billion in 2011. With this growth in adoption, becoming increasingly common even for small and midsize businesses, security is becoming a much more serious concern, both in terms of how to secure virtualization and how virtualization can serve critical security objectives. Titles exist and are on the way to fill the need for securing virtualization, but security professionals do not yet have a book outlining the many security applications of virtualization that will become increasingly important in their job requirements. This book is the first to fill that need, covering tactics such as isolating a virtual environment on the desktop for application testing, creating virtualized storage solutions for immediate disaster recovery and high availability across a network, migrating physical systems to virtual systems for analysis, and creating complete virtual systems to entice hackers and expose potential threats to actual production systems.About the TechnologiesA sandbox is an isolated environment created to run and test applications that might be a security risk. Recovering a compromised system is as easy as restarting the virtual machine to revert to the point before failure. Employing virtualization on actual production systems, rather than just test environments, yields similar benefits for disaster recovery and high availability. While traditional disaster recovery methods require time-consuming reinstallation of the operating system and applications before restoring data, backing up to a virtual machine makes the recovery process much easier, faster, and efficient. The virtual machine can be restored to same physical machine or an entirely different machine if the original machine has experienced irreparable hardware failure. Decreased downtime translates into higher availability of the system and increased productivity in the enterprise.Virtualization has been used for years in the field of forensic analysis, but new tools, techniques, and automation capabilities are making it an increasingly important tool. By means of virtualization, an investigator can create an exact working copy of a physical computer on another machine, including hidden or encrypted partitions, without altering any data, allowing complete access for analysis. The investigator can also take a live ?snapshot? to review or freeze the target computer at any point in time, before an attacker has a chance to cover his tracks or inflict further damage.
translatedDescription: Una de las palabras de zumbido más grandes de la industria de TI durante los últimos años, la virtualización ha madurado en un requisito práctico para muchos escenarios de negocios de mejores prácticas, convirtiéndose en una herramienta invaluable para los profesionales de seguridad en las empresas de todos los tamaños. Además de ahorrar tiempo y otros recursos, la virtualización ofrece medios sin precedentes para la intrusión y detección de malware, prevención, recuperación y análisis. Tomando un enfoque práctico en un mercado en crecimiento bajo la conservación de los libros, este título práctico es el primero en combinar en un solo lugar los usos más importantes y buscados de la virtualización para mejorar la seguridad, incluyendo sandboxing, recuperación de desastres y alta disponibilidad, análisis forenses, y almacenamiento de miel. La investigación de Gartner indica que la virtualización será la tendencia más significativa en la infraestructura y las operaciones de TI en los próximos cuatro años. Un informe reciente de la firma de investigación de TI IDC predice que el mercado de servicios de virtualización crecerá de 5.500 millones de dólares en 2006 a 11.700 millones en 2011. Con este crecimiento en la adopción, cada vez más común incluso para las pequeñas y medianas empresas, la seguridad se está convirtiendo en una preocupación mucho más grave, tanto en términos de cómo asegurar la virtualización como de cómo la virtualización puede servir a objetivos críticos de seguridad. Los títulos existen y están en camino para llenar la necesidad de asegurar la virtualización, pero los profesionales de la seguridad todavía no tienen un libro que esboza las muchas aplicaciones de seguridad de la virtualización que se volverán cada vez más importantes en sus requisitos de trabajo. Este libro es el primero en llenar esa necesidad, cubriendo tácticas como aislar un entorno virtual en el escritorio para la prueba de aplicaciones, creando soluciones de almacenamiento virtualizadas para la recuperación inmediata de desastres y alta disponibilidad en toda una red, migrando sistemas físicos a sistemas virtuales para el análisis, y creando sistemas virtuales completos para atraer hackers y exponer posibles amenazas a sistemas de producción reales. Acerca de TechnologiesA sandbox es un entorno aislado creado para ejecutar y probar aplicaciones que podrían ser un riesgo de seguridad. Recovering a compromised system is as easy as restarting the virtual machine to revert to the point before failure. Emplear la virtualización en sistemas de producción reales, en lugar de entornos de prueba, produce beneficios similares para la recuperación en casos de desastre y una alta disponibilidad. Mientras que los métodos tradicionales de recuperación de desastres requieren una reinstalación prolongada del sistema operativo y las aplicaciones antes de restaurar datos, el respaldo a una máquina virtual hace que el proceso de recuperación sea mucho más fácil, rápido y eficiente. La máquina virtual puede ser restaurada a la misma máquina física o una máquina completamente diferente si la máquina original ha experimentado un fallo de hardware irreparable. La disminución del tiempo de inactividad se traduce en una mayor disponibilidad del sistema y una mayor productividad en la empresa. La virtualización se ha utilizado durante años en el campo del análisis forense, pero nuevas herramientas, técnicas y capacidades de automatización lo hacen una herramienta cada vez más importante. Mediante la virtualización, un investigador puede crear una copia de trabajo exacta de un ordenador físico en otra máquina, incluyendo particiones ocultas o encriptadas, sin alterar ningún dato, permitiendo el acceso completo para el análisis. El investigador también puede tomar una captura en vivo?snapshot? para revisar o congelar el ordenador objetivo en cualquier momento, antes de que un atacante tenga la oportunidad de cubrir sus pistas o causar nuevos daños.

title: Spring: A Developer's Notebook
description:
Since development first began on Spring in 2003, there's been a constant buzz about it in Java development publications and corporate IT departments. The reason is clear: Spring is a lightweight Java framework in a world of complex heavyweight architectures that take forever to implement. Spring is like a breath of fresh air to overworked developers.In Spring, you can make an object secure, remote, or transactional, with a couple of lines of configuration instead of embedded code. The resulting application is simple and clean. In Spring, you can work less and go home early, because you can strip away a whole lot of the redundant code that you tend to see in most J2EE applications. You won't be nearly as burdened with meaningless detail. In Spring, you can change your mind without the consequences bleeding through your entire application. You'll adapt much more quickly than you ever could before.Spring: A Developer's Notebook offers a quick dive into the new Spring framework, designed to let you get hands-on as quickly as you like. If you don't want to bother with a lot of theory, this book is definitely for you. You'll work through one example after another. Along the way, you'll discover the energy and promise of the Spring framework.This practical guide features ten code-intensive labs that'll rapidly get you up to speed. You'll learn how to do the following, and more:

install the Spring Framework
set up the development environment
use Spring with other open source Java tools such as Tomcat, Struts, and Hibernate
master AOP and transactions
utilize ORM solutions
As with all titles in the Developer's Notebook series, this no-nonsense book skips all the boring prose and cuts right to the chase. It's an approach that forces you to get your hands dirty by working through one instructional example after another-examples that speak to you instead of at you.

title: JavaScript Pocket Reference

It allows you to create dynamic, interactive Web-based applications that run completely within a Web browser -- JavaScript is the language of choice for developing Dynamic HTML (DHTML) content. JavaScript can be integrated effectively with CGI and Java to produce sophisticated Web applications, although, in many cases, JavaScript eliminates the need for complex CGI scripts and Java applets altogether. The JavaScript Pocket Reference is a companion volume to JavaScript: The Definitive Guide. This small book, covering JavaScript 1.2, is a handy reference guide to this popular language for Web development. It provides a complete overview of the core JavaScript language and contains summaries of both core and client-side objects, methods, and properties.

His approach emphasizes practicality and clarity, ensuring that readers leave with actionable skills.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for system administrators, application developers, and IT professionals aiming to achieve high availability using JBoss EAP6. Readers should have a basic understanding of Linux/Unix-based systems. Whether you're designing your first cluster or optimizing an existing one, this book provides valuable insights and techniques for deploying robust JBoss solutions.
translatedDescription:
JBoss EAP6 High Availability es su guía definitiva para crear grupos de alta disponibilidad utilizando las capacidades avanzadas de JBoss EAP6. Con pasos prácticos, usted aprenderá a configurar y gestionar JBoss agrupando, implementar un equilibrio de carga eficaz con mod jk y mod cluster, y asegurar su entorno con SSL.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Entender y configurar JBoss EAP6 para la gestión de dominios y alta disponibilidad.
Implementar técnicas de equilibrio de carga usando mod jk y mod cluster para mejorar el rendimiento de la aplicación.
Aplique configuraciones SSL para asegurar datos y comunicación dentro de su grupo.
Configurar la replicación de sesión para experiencias de usuario sin problemas en entornos agrupados.
Solución de problemas y optimización de soluciones de agrupación JBoss para una prestación de servicios robusta.

Autor(s)

Weinan Li es un desarrollador de software experimentado y educador con énfasis en plataformas de aplicaciones empresariales y sistemas de alta disponibilidad. Ha trabajado extensamente con las tecnologías JBoss y aporta años de experiencia práctica a esta guía. Su enfoque hace hincapié en la practicidad y la claridad, asegurando que los lectores abandonen con habilidades prácticas.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para administradores de sistemas, desarrolladores de aplicaciones y profesionales de TI que buscan lograr una alta disponibilidad utilizando JBoss EAP6. Los lectores deben tener una comprensión básica de los sistemas basados en Linux/Unix. Ya sea que esté diseñando su primer cluster o optimizando uno existente, este libro proporciona valiosas ideas y técnicas para implementar soluciones JBoss robustas.

title: Java 2™ Programmer Exam Cram™ 2 (Exam CX-310-035)
description:
This exam measures the ability to design, write, and understand programs written in language version 1.4 of the Java 2 Platform. The programmer¿s exam concentrates on the language basics. This book is not intended to teach new material. Instead it assumes that you have a solid foundation of knowledge but can use a refresher on important concepts as well as a guide to exam topics and objectives. This book focuses exactly on what you need to pass the exam - it features test-taking strategies, time-saving study tips, and a special Cram Sheet that includes tips, acronyms, and memory joggers not available anywhere else. The series is supported online at several Web sites: examcram.com, informit.com, and cramsession.com.

The accompanying CD features PrepLogic™ Practice Tests, Preview Edition. This product includes one complete PrepLogic Practice Test with approximately the same number of questions found on the actual vendor exam. Each question contains full, detailed explanations of the correct and incorrect answers. The engine offers two study modes, Practice Test and Flash Review, full exam customization, and a detailed score report.

En cambio, supone que usted tiene una sólida base de conocimiento, pero puede utilizar un refresco sobre conceptos importantes, así como una guía para examinar temas y objetivos. title: ES6 for Humans: The Latest Standard of JavaScript: ES2015 and Beyond
description:
Learn ES6 best practices for code optimization and organization and walk through practical, common examples of how to implement complete components of your applications. While this book covers the basic concepts of modern JavaScript, it primarily focuses on the new syntax, data-types, functionalities, and everything else that's new in ES6, the latest standard of JavaScript. 
You'll examine how to use ES6 in functional programming and explore the new more modular and object-oriented approach to JavaScript. This book will help you sharpen and upgrade your JavaScript language skills so you to easily explore modern ES6 based frameworks or libraries such as ReactJS, ReactNative, Angular4 and Vue.js.
ES6 for Humans  is a complete guide to writing ES6 and will enable you to start taking advantage of this exciting new version of JavaScript. 
What
You'll Learn
Use all the new features added to JavaScript
Compare ES5 and ES6 in varied situations
Refresh your core JavaScript fundamentals
Understand the modular and object-oriented approach to JavaScript
Who this Book Is For
Any Javascript developer who wants to fully understand and dive into the new features of ES6/ES2015. 
Developers with some background in programming, preferably in JavaScript.  
A basic understanding of coding concepts and exposure to object-oriented programming is expected.
translatedDescription:
Aprende ES6 mejores prácticas para la optimización y organización de códigos y recorre ejemplos prácticos y comunes de cómo implementar componentes completos de tus aplicaciones. Mientras que este libro cubre los conceptos básicos de JavaScript moderno, se centra principalmente en la nueva sintaxis, tipos de datos, funcionalidades, y todo lo demás que es nuevo en ES6, el último estándar de JavaScript.
Examinará cómo utilizar ES6 en programación funcional y explorará el nuevo enfoque más modular y orientado hacia objetos a JavaScript. Este libro le ayudará a agudizar y mejorar sus habilidades de lenguaje JavaScript para explorar fácilmente marcos basados en ES6 modernos o bibliotecas como ReactJS, ReactNative, Angular4 y Vue.js.
ES6 for Humans es una guía completa para escribir ES6 y le permitirá comenzar a aprovechar esta nueva versión emocionante de JavaScript.
¿Qué?
Aprenderás
Utilice todas las nuevas características agregadas a JavaScript
Comparar ES5 y ES6 en situaciones variadas
Refresque su núcleo Fundamentos de JavaScript
Comprender el enfoque modular y orientado al objeto de JavaScript
Quién es este libro
Cualquier desarrollador de Javascript que quiera comprender y sumergirse en las nuevas características de ES6/ES2015.
Desarrolladores con algún fondo en programación, preferiblemente en JavaScript.
Se espera una comprensión básica de los conceptos de codificación y la exposición a la programación orientada hacia objetos.

title: Apache Jakarta and Beyond: A Java Programmer’s Introduction
description:
"If you're a Java developer interested in leveraging open source tools to build multitier applications, Larne Pekowsky can help--this book will walk you all the way through development, build, testing, and deployment. This soup-to-nuts coverage is a rare find."

--Angela Yochem, author of J2EE Applications and BEA WebLogic Server, Second Edition (Prentice Hall, 2004)

The Jakarta project consists of many powerful open source tools for the Java platform, but most lack tutorials or clear online help documentation. Apache Jakarta and Beyond is the definitive guide to using Jakarta and other Java open source tools to develop Web applications more efficiently and effectively.

In this example-packed book, readers will find

An introduction to the philosophy behind the Jakarta project

Details on many ready-to-use Java toolkits, including Ant, JUnit, Cactus, Log4J, POI, Tomcat, James, Struts, and more

In-depth guidelines on how to develop with multiple toolkits

A guide to splitting work along lines of "what is available" and "what must be written"

Best practices for development, such as the model/view/controller paradigm

Numerous examples that can serve as templates for readers' own projects

The accompanying CD-ROM contains templates and complete code examples from the book.

Whether you are developing client applications, Web applications, or Web services, Apache Jakarta and Beyond will help you use existing code to simplify the task at hand.
translatedDescription:
"Si eres un desarrollador Java interesado en aprovechar las herramientas de código abierto para construir aplicaciones multitier, Larne Pekowsky puede ayudar--este libro te guiará por el desarrollo, la construcción, la prueba y la implementación. Esta cobertura de sopa a nueces es un hallazgo raro".

--Angela Yochem, autor de J2EE Applications y BEA WebLogic Server, Second Edition (Prentice Hall, 2004)

El proyecto Yakarta consta de muchas herramientas de código abierto para la plataforma Java, pero la mayoría carece de tutoriales o documentación de ayuda en línea clara. Apache Jakarta y Beyond es la guía definitiva para utilizar Yakarta y otras herramientas de código abierto de Java para desarrollar aplicaciones web de manera más eficiente y eficaz.

En este libro lleno de ejemplos, los lectores encontrarán

Introducción a la filosofía detrás del proyecto Yakarta

Detalles sobre muchos kits de herramientas Java listos para usar, incluyendo Ant, JUnit, Cactus, Log4J, POI, Tomcat, James, Struts, y más

Directrices detalladas sobre cómo desarrollarse con múltiples herramientas

Una guía para dividir el trabajo en líneas de "lo que está disponible" y "lo que debe ser escrito"

Las mejores prácticas para el desarrollo, como el paradigma modelo/view/controller

Numerosos ejemplos que pueden servir como plantillas para proyectos de lectores

El CD-ROM adjunto contiene plantillas y ejemplos de código completo del libro.

Ya sea que esté desarrollando aplicaciones cliente, aplicaciones Web o servicios Web, Apache Yakarta y Beyond le ayudará a utilizar el código existente para simplificar la tarea a la mano.

title: Your First Week With React
description:
React is a remarkable JavaScript library that' taken the development community by storm. In a nutshell, it's made it easier for developers to build interactive user interfaces for web, mobile and desktop platforms. One of its best features is its freedom from the problematic bugs inherent in MVC frameworks, where inconsistent views is a recurring problem for big projects. Today, thousands of companies worldwide are using React, including big names such as Netflix and AirBnB. React has become immensely popular, such that a number of apps have been ported to React -- including WhatsApp, Instagram and Dropbox.

This book is a collection of tutorials, selected from SitePoint's React Hub, that will guide you through your first days with the amazingly flexible library.
translatedDescription:
React es una notable biblioteca JavaScript que' tomó la comunidad de desarrollo por tormenta. En pocas palabras, es más fácil para los desarrolladores construir interfaces de usuario interactivas para plataformas web, móviles y de escritorio. Una de sus mejores características es su libertad de los errores problemáticos inherentes a los marcos MVC, donde las opiniones inconsistentes son un problema recurrente para los grandes proyectos. Hoy, miles de empresas de todo el mundo utilizan React, incluyendo grandes nombres como Netflix y AirBnB. React se ha vuelto inmensamente popular, de tal manera que varias aplicaciones han sido portadas para React -- incluyendo WhatsApp, Instagram y Dropbox.

Este libro es una colección de tutoriales, seleccionados del Centro de Reacción de SitePoint, que le guiará a través de sus primeros días con la biblioteca increíblemente flexible.

title: Pro JavaScript™ Techniques
description:
Pro JavaScript Techniques is the ultimate JavaScript book for the modern web developer. It provides everything you need to know about modern JavaScript, and shows what JavaScript can do for your web sites. This book doesn't waste any time looking at things you already know, like basic syntax and structures.

Expert web developer and author John Resig concentrates on fundamental, vital topics—what modern JavaScripting is (and isnt), the current state of browser support, and pitfalls to be wary of. The book is organized into four sections:

Modern JavaScript development using JavaScript the object-oriented way, creating reusable code, plus testing and debugging

DOM scripting updating content and styles, plus events, and effect and event libraries

How Ajax works, overcoming problems, and using libraries to speed up development of Ajax applications

The future of JavaScript looking at cutting edge topics like JSON, HTML5, and more

All concepts are backed up by real-world examples and case studies, and John provides numerous reusable functions and classes to save you time in your development. There are also up-to-date reference appendixes for the DOM, events, browser support (including IE7), and frameworks, so you can look up specific details quickly and easily.
translatedDescription:
Pro JavaScript Techniques es el último libro JavaScript para el desarrollador web moderno. Proporciona todo lo que necesitas saber sobre JavaScript moderno, y muestra lo que JavaScript puede hacer para tus sitios web. Este libro no pierde tiempo mirando cosas que ya sabes, como sintaxis básica y estructuras.

El desarrollador web experto y el autor John Resig se concentra en temas fundamentales y vitales: lo moderno que es JavaScript (y está doblado), el estado actual de soporte del navegador, y los obstáculos para ser cuidadosos. El libro se organiza en cuatro secciones:

Modern JavaScript development using JavaScript the object-oriented way, creating reusable code, plus testing and debugging

DOM scripting actualización de contenidos y estilos, más eventos y bibliotecas de efectos y eventos

Cómo funciona Ajax, superando problemas y utilizando bibliotecas para acelerar el desarrollo de aplicaciones Ajax

El futuro de JavaScript mirando temas de vanguardia como JSON, HTML5, y más

Todos los conceptos están respaldados por ejemplos reales y estudios de casos, y John proporciona numerosas funciones y clases reutilizables para ahorrar tiempo en su desarrollo. También hay apéndices de referencia actualizados para el DOM, eventos, soporte del navegador (incluyendo IE7), y marcos, para que pueda buscar detalles específicos de forma rápida y sencilla.

title: The Java™ EE 5 Tutorial, Third Edition: For Sun Java System Application Server Platform Edition 9
description:
The Java EE 5 Tutorial is an introduction to programming server-side Java applications. This book takes a task-oriented, example-driven approach to show you how to build applications for the Java EE 5 platform. This book also describes the features and functionalities available with NetBeans 5.5.

What's new in this edition? The author team have updated the existing chapters to reflect the changes to JSP, EJB, Servlets, and more. Also, the authors have added new chapters on the Sun Java System Application Server 9 as a deployment environment for server-side technologies. The web-tier technology chapters cover the components used in developing the presentation layer of a Java EE 5 or stand-alone web application. The web services technology chapters cover the APIs used in developing standard web services. The Enterprise JavaBeans (EJB) technology chapters cover the components used in developing the business logic of a Java EE 5 application. The Persistence technology chapters cover the Java Persistence API, which is used for accessing databases from Java EE applications. The platform services chapters cover the system services used by all the Java EE 5 component technologies
translatedDescription:
El Tutorial Java EE 5 es una introducción a las aplicaciones Java del servidor de programación. Este libro toma un enfoque orientado a tareas, basado en ejemplos para mostrarte cómo construir aplicaciones para la plataforma Java EE 5. Este libro también describe las características y funcionalidades disponibles con NetBeans 5.5.

¿Qué hay de nuevo en esta edición? El equipo del autor ha actualizado los capítulos existentes para reflejar los cambios a JSP, EJB, Servlets y más. Además, los autores han añadido nuevos capítulos en el Sun Java System Application Server 9 como un entorno de implementación para tecnologías lado servidor. Los capítulos de tecnología de nivel web cubren los componentes utilizados para desarrollar la capa de presentación de una aplicación web Java EE 5 o independiente. Los capítulos de tecnología de servicios web abarcan las API utilizadas en el desarrollo de servicios web estándar. Los capítulos tecnológicos Enterprise JavaBeans (EJB) cubren los componentes utilizados para desarrollar la lógica empresarial de una aplicación Java EE 5. Los capítulos de tecnología Persistence cubren la API de Persistencia Java, que se utiliza para acceder a bases de datos de aplicaciones Java EE. Los capítulos de servicios de plataforma cubren los servicios del sistema utilizados por todas las tecnologías componentes Java EE 5

title: PrimeFaces Cookbook
description:

What this Book will help me do

Discover the setup and configuration essentials to start using PrimeFaces effectively.
Gain in-depth knowledge of PrimeFaces components and how to integrate them into your JSF applications.
Learn best practices and techniques to improve application performance and usability.

title: Sams Teach Yourself Java 2 in 21 Days, Second Edition
description: Sams Teach Yourself Java in 21 Days, Second Edition is known for its clear and personable writing, its extensive use of examples, and its logical step-by-step organization. title: Backbone.js Testing
description:
"Backbone.js Testing" is a step-by-step guide to building and refining test infrastructures for Backbone.js applications. Through practical examples, readers will learn to write and run effective test suites, making their applications more robust and maintainable.

What this Book will help me do

Set up a testing infrastructure for Backbone.js applications.
Analyze test results using Mocha test reports.
Master the Chai assertion library with practical examples.
Learn to write detailed and effective test suites using Mocha.
Utilize Sinon.JS to mock behaviors, create spies, and simulate servers for tests.

Author(s)

Ryan Glenn Roemer, the author of "Backbone.js Testing," is a software developer with a passion for testing and ensuring the robustness of applications. He has extensive experience in JavaScript and test-driven development practices. Ryan brings his expertise to this book with a clear and practical approach to teaching testing skills.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for developers working on Backbone.js applications who want to improve their testing skills and ensure their applications are reliable. Whether you are new to testing in JavaScript or looking to enhance your existing knowledge, the step-by-step recipes and tutorials will provide the guidance you need to succeed. The book assumes some familiarity with Backbone.js and JavaScript basics.
translatedDescription:
"Backbone.js Testing" es una guía paso a paso para construir y refinar infraestructuras de pruebas para aplicaciones Backbone.js. A través de ejemplos prácticos, los lectores aprenderán a escribir y ejecutar suites de prueba eficaces, haciendo sus aplicaciones más robustas y sostenibles.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Establecer una infraestructura de pruebas para aplicaciones Backbone.js.
Analizar los resultados de la prueba utilizando informes de prueba Mocha.
Maestro la biblioteca de afirmaciones Chai con ejemplos prácticos.
Aprende a escribir suites de prueba detalladas y eficaces usando Mocha.
Utilizar Sinon.JS para burlar comportamientos, crear espías y simular servidores para pruebas.

Autor(s)

Ryan Glenn Roemer, autor de "Backbone.js Testing", es un desarrollador de software con pasión por las pruebas y asegurar la robustez de las aplicaciones. Ya sea nuevo para probar en JavaScript o para mejorar tu conocimiento existente, las recetas y tutoriales paso a paso proporcionarán la guía que necesitas para tener éxito. El libro asume cierta familiaridad con Backbone.js y conceptos básicos de JavaScript.

title: Sams Teach Yourself jQuery Mobile in 24 Hours

Each short, easy lesson builds on all that's come before, teaching jQuery Mobile's newest features in the context of real solution development. Quizzes y Ejercicios construyen y prueban el conocimiento... "¿Sabías?" consejos ofrecen consejos y atajos interiores... y alertas "¡Espera!" ayudan a los lectores a evitar problemas. Para cuando terminen, los lectores estarán cómodos yendo más allá del libro para "movilizar" prácticamente cualquier sitio.

Everything you need to get going with Java!

title: Runtime Performance Metrics and Performance Optimization
description: The video collection is a one-stop-shop for all things JavaScript regardless of if you are a seasoned program manager or a new hire, junior developer. These bite-sized videos cover everything from the basics to advanced techniques: dive into JavaScript's syntax, understand its role in web development, and explore topics like variables, functions, and asynchronous programming. We'll walk through concepts like transpiling and server-side JavaScript, so you can impress your team with your newfound knowledge. Why should you care? Critical issues covered include disk quotas, fragmentation, optimization, hard drive reliability, asset management, software deployment, and system forensics. Students and IT newcomers can access multiple definitions and examples of fundamentals such as disk organization, file systems, and basic maintenance actions. Chapters examining hardware and software management and industry trends provide further insight into how you can maintain and monitor disks and have them perform at maximum efficiency.

title: Big Data Analytics Using Splunk: Deriving Operational Intelligence from Social Media, Machine Data, Existing Data Warehouses, and Other Real-Time Streaming Sources
description:
Big Data Analytics Using Splunk is a hands-on book showing how to process and derive business value from big data in real time. Examples in the book draw from social media sources such as Twitter (tweets) and Foursquare (check-ins). You also learn to draw from machine data, enabling you to analyze, say, web server log files and patterns of user access in real time, as the access is occurring. Gone are the days when you need be caught out by shifting public opinion or sudden changes in customer behavior. Splunk's easy to use engine helps you recognize and react in real time, as events are occurring.

Splunk is a powerful, yet simple analytical tool fast gaining traction in the fields of big data and operational intelligence. Using Splunk, you can monitor data in real time, or mine your data after the fact. Splunk's stunning visualizations aid in locating the needle of value in a haystack of a data. Geolocation support spreads your data across a map, allowing you to drill down to geographic areas of interest. Alerts can run in the background and trigger to warn you of shifts or events as they are taking place.

With Splunk you can immediately recognize and react to changing trends and shifting public opinion as expressed through social media, and to new patterns of eCommerce and customer behavior. The ability to immediately recognize and react to changing trends provides a tremendous advantage in today's fast-paced world of Internet business. Big Data Analytics Using Splunk opens the door to an exciting world of real-time operational intelligence.

Built around hands-on projects

Shows how to mine social media

Opens the door to real-time operational intelligence

What you'll learn

Monitor and mine social media for trends affecting your business

Know how you are perceived, and when that perception is rising or falling

Detect changing customer behavior from mining your operational data

Collect and analyze in real time, or from historical files

Apply basic analytical metrics to better understand your data

Create compelling visualizations and easily communicate your findings

Who this book is for

Big Data Analytics Using Splunk is for those who are interested in exploring the heaps of data they have available, but don't know where to start. It is for the people who have knowledge of the data they want to analyze and are developers or SQL programmers at a level anywhere between beginners and intermediate. Expert developers also benefit from learning how to use such a simple and powerful tool as Splunk.

title: Security on z/VM
description:
Discussions about server sprawl, rising software costs, going green, or moving data centers to reduce the cost of business are held in many meetings or conference calls in many organizations throughout the world. And many organizations are starting to turn toward System z™ and z/VM® after such discussions. The virtual machine operating system has over 40 years of experience as a hosting platform for servers, from the days of VM/SP, VM/XA, VM/ESA® and especially now with z/VM. With the consolidation of servers and conservative estimates that approximately seventy percent of all critical corporate data reside on System z, we find ourselves needing a highly secure environment for the support of this infrastructure. This document was written to assist z/VM support and security personnel in providing the enterprise with a safe, secure and manageable environment.

This IBM® Redbooks® publication provides an overview of security and integrity provided by z/VM and the processes for the implementation and configuration of z/VM Security Server, z/VM LDAP Server, IBM Tivoli® Directory Server for z/OS®, and Linux® on System z with PAM for LDAP authentication.

Sample scenarios with RACF® database sharing between z/VM and z/OS, or through Tivoli Directory Integrator to synchronize LDAP databases, are also discussed in this book.

This book provides information about configuration and usage of Linux on System z with the System z Cryptographic features documenting their hardware and software configuration.

The Consul zSecure Pro Suite is also part of this document: this product helps to control and audit security not only on one system, but can be used as a single point of enterprise wide security control. This document covers the installation and configuration of this product and detailed information is presented on how z/Consul can be used to collect and analyze z/VM security data and how it can be helpful in the administration of your audit data.
