title: iTunes Music: Mastering High Resolution Audio Delivery
description:
Apple’s exciting new Mastered for iTunes (MFiT) initiative, introduced in early 2012, introduces new possibilities for delivering high-quality audio. For the first time, record labels and program producers are encouraged to deliver audio materials to iTunes in a high resolution format, which can produce better-sounding masters.

In iTunes Music, author and world-class mastering engineer Bob Katz starts out with the basics, surveys the recent past, and brings you quickly up to the present—where the current state of digital audio is bleak. Katz explains the evolution of standards for dynamic range through the present and with implications for the future. He details the new methods that Apple is developing to accept high resolution audio and shows step by step how audio engineers and producers can take advantage of them.

This book is designed for all those dealing with sound, from sound engineers to music industry executives and musicians—and those aspiring to all these roles. This book will help you understand the issues around delivering high-quality environment and get all your facts straight for when you encounter resistance to good sound.

Topics covered include:

• Contrasting the production of CD albums with iTunes albums • High Resolution audio • Dithering • Distortion (and how to avoid it) • Lossy Coding • Loudness Metering • Sound Check and how it affects our production techniques • Apple’s tools for Mastered for iTunes

Foreword by renowned mastering engineer Bob Ludwig.

Join the forums at www.digido.com/iTunes, for the latest information and discussions!

En iTunes Music, el autor y el ingeniero de masterización de clase mundial Bob Katz comienza con los fundamentos, explora el pasado reciente, y te lleva rápidamente hasta el presente, donde el estado actual de audio digital es sombrío. Katz explica la evolución de los estándares para el rango dinámico a través del presente y con implicaciones para el futuro. title: Restful Java Web Services Security
description:
Restful Java Web Services Security is a practical guide that will equip you with the knowledge and skills needed to secure your RESTful web services effectively. Through hands-on examples and clear explanations, you will learn how to implement essential security measures and protect your applications against common vulnerabilities. By the end of this book, you will feel confident in securing your web services securely and robustly.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the core security concepts specific to RESTful web services and how to apply them.
Set up and configure secure environments for developing and testing RESTful applications.
Integrate OAuth and SSO mechanisms into your RESTful services for added security and ease of access.
Learn and apply encryption and digital signatures to improve message security.
Acquire the skills needed to identify, implement, and test secure communication protocols for your applications.

Author(s)

None Enríquez is an experienced software developer and author with a deep expertise in Java and web services security. Drawing from real-world experience, Enríquez focuses on presenting practical solutions to complex problems. Their teaching approach emphasizes clarity and applicability, making challenging topics accessible to developers of all experience levels.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for web developers and technical professionals looking to develop secure RESTful web services. Whether you are new to working with RESTful architectures or have some experience but want to deepen your understanding of security practices, this book is for you. If your goal is to enhance your applications with robust security protocols and understand common vulnerabilities, you will find this guide immensely valuable. The content is also beneficial for those wanting to learn about OAuth, SSO, and encryption techniques in the context of RESTful services.

title: JavaScript for Web Developers: Understanding the Basics
description:
Learn the basics of JavaScript to enhance your web pages. This book focuses on modern JavaScript programming and encourages a well-organized approach to programming in general.

 

JavaScript for Web Developers explains each foundational concept of the language, followed by a practical implementation of that lesson to reinforce what you’ve learned. Author Mark Simon starts with the basics of JavaScript programming, followed by a tutorial on manipulating HTML elements. You will then learn to work with forms, along with CSS and Event Listeners. Hands-on projects will not only solidify each concept in your mind, but they will also give you greater confidence and help you absorb best practices. The book concludes with coverage of Ajax, which will enable you to send and retrieve data from a server asynchronously without interfering with the display and behavior of an existing web page.

 

After reading this book, you will be able to use JavaScript to design and program your own web applications.

 

What Will You Learn

Understand the basics of JavaScript programming
Manipulate and modify web pages with JavaScript
Use JavaScript to interact with HTML and CSS
Work with data and understand the basics of working with Ajax

 

Who Is This Book For

Beginning web developers with little to no experience using JavaScript.

title: JUnit Recipes

title: Building a Monitoring Infrastructure with Nagios
description:
Build real-world, end-to-end network monitoring solutions with Nagios

This is the definitive guide to building low-cost, enterprise-strength monitoring infrastructures with Nagios, the world’s leading open source monitoring tool. Network monitoring specialist David Josephsen goes far beyond the basics, demonstrating how to use third-party tools and plug-ins to solve the specific problems in your unique environment. Josephsen introduces Nagios “from the ground up,” showing how to plan for success and leverage today’s most valuable monitoring best practices. Then, using practical examples, real directives, and working code, Josephsen presents detailed monitoring solutions for Windows, Unix, Linux, network equipment, and other platforms and devices. You’ll find thorough discussions of advanced topics, including the use of data visualization to solve complex monitoring problems. This is also the first Nagios book with comprehensive coverage of using Nagios Event Broker to transform and extend Nagios.

Understand how Nagios works, in depth: the host and service paradigm, plug-ins, scheduling, and notification

Configure Nagios successfully: config files, templates, timeperiods, contacts, hosts, services, escalations, dependencies, and more

Streamline deployment with scripting templates, automated discovery, and Nagios GUI tools

Use plug-ins and tools to systematically monitor the devices and platforms you need to monitor, the way you need to monitor them

Establish front-ends, visual dashboards, and management interfaces with MRTG and RRDTool

Build new C-based Nagios Event Broker (NEB) modules, one step at a time

Contains easy-to-understand code listings in Unix shell, C, and Perl

If you’re responsible for systems monitoring infrastructure in any organization, large or small, this book will help you achieve the results you want–right from the start.

David Josephsen is Senior Systems Engineer at DBG, Inc., where he maintains a collection of geographically dispersed server farms. He has more than a decade of hands-on experience with Unix systems, routers, firewalls, and load balancers in support of complex, high-volume networks. Josephsen’s certifications include CISSP, CCNA, CCDA, and MCSE. His co-authored work on Bayesian spam filtering earned a Best Paper award at USENIX LISA 2004. He has been published in both ;login and Sysadmin magazines on topics relating to security, systems monitoring, and spam mitigation.

title: The Wireshark Field Guide
description:
The Wireshark Field Guide provides hackers, pen testers, and network administrators with practical guidance on capturing and interactively browsing computer network traffic. Wireshark is the world's foremost network protocol analyzer, with a rich feature set that includes deep inspection of hundreds of protocols, live capture, offline analysis and many other features.

The Wireshark Field Guide covers the installation, configuration and use of this powerful multi-platform tool. The book give readers the hands-on skills to be more productive with Wireshark as they drill down into the information contained in real-time network traffic. Readers will learn the fundamentals of packet capture and inspection, the use of color codes and filters, deep analysis, including probes and taps, and much more.

The Wireshark Field Guide is an indispensable companion for network technicians, operators, and engineers.

Learn the fundamentals of using Wireshark in a concise field manual
Quickly create functional filters that will allow you to get to work quickly on solving problems
Understand the myriad of options and the deep functionality of Wireshark
Solve common network problems
Learn some advanced features, methods and helpful ways to work more quickly and efficiently

La Guía de campo de Wireshark cubre la instalación, configuración y uso de esta poderosa herramienta multiplataforma. El libro da a los lectores las habilidades prácticas para ser más productivos con Wireshark mientras se perforan en la información contenida en el tráfico de red en tiempo real. Los lectores aprenderán los fundamentos de la captura e inspección de paquetes, el uso de códigos y filtros de color, análisis profundo, incluyendo sondas y grifos, y mucho más.

Leverage Nagios Core to monitor services, hosts, and applications efficiently.

title: Automating vSphere: With VMware vCenter Orchestrator
description:
Unleash the Power of vCenter Orchestrator to Automate Tasks and Improve Efficiency

Today, VMware administrators are responsible for far more infrastructure, servers, and services than ever before. To succeed, they must take full advantage of opportunities to automate and orchestrate their vSphere environments. In Automating vSphere with VMware vCenter Orchestrator, three-time vExpert Cody Bunch shows how to utilize VMware vCenter Orchestrator (vCO) 4.2 to achieve far higher levels of operational efficiency and effectiveness.

Bunch reveals what vCO can do, walks through each step of installation and configuration, explains how its “moving parts” work together, and thoroughly introduces both plug-ins and workflows. Building on this core knowledge, he presents several start-to-finish case studies showing how to use vCO to address real-world challenges ranging from provisioning to snapshots, cluster management to decommissioning.

Whatever your VMware virtualization environment, this book will help you do more with less, save time, eliminate errors, and improve both performance and reliability.

Coverage includes

Understanding how vCO fits into your environment and identifying your best opportunities to use it

Choosing the right installation scenario and efficiently managing the vCO installation process

Configuring vCO: services, passwords, networking, LDAP, databases, SSL, licensing, plug-ins, backup, and more

Interacting with vCO through actions, packages, plug-ins, web views, resources, and workflows

Automating manual tasks with vCO’s extensive workflow library

Creating sophisticated workflows with drag-and-drop components and JavaScript

Using plug-ins to control infrastructure within and around your vSphere environment

Bringing consistency to VM provisioning, overcoming “VM sprawl” and resource contention, and simplifying support

Optimizing VM lifecycle management, all the way through decommissioning

Automating all snapshot monitoring processes and components

Exporting logs, finding/deleting orphaned files, and performing other day-to-day tasks

Efficiently conducting mass VM migrations

Quickly adding vCenter hosts and clusters, configuring shared storage, and adding hosts to new clusters

Using vCO and third-party plug-ins to gain “private cloud” benefits and flexibility

Networking/Virtualization

title: Building Java Enterprise Applications
description: What are the key decisions and tradeoffs you face as you design and develop enterprise applications? How do you build the back end so that it not only handles your current needs but is flexible enough to allow your system to evolve as your needs expand? Answer these questions and many more with Building Java Enterprise Applications, an advanced guide to building complex Java Enterprise Applications from the ground up that addresses design issues along the way. These practical books take a step back from detailed examination of the APIs and focus on the entire picture, so you can put the pieces together and build something that works! This book explores the infrastructure issues so important to good application design. It isn't just a book about doing things with Entity Beans, JDBC and JMS and JNDI. It takes you step by step through building the back end, designing the data store so that it gives you convenient access to the data your application needs; designing a directory; figuring out how to handle security and where to store security credentials you need; and so on. On top of this, it shows -- as easily as possible --how to build the entity bean layer that makes information available to the rest of the application. Throughout this guide, author Brett McLaughlin uses his wealth of real-world experience with enterprise development to show you one step at a time how to design and build a comprehensive enterprise application from the ground up, starting with the back end.
translatedDescription: ¿Cuáles son las decisiones clave y los intercambios que enfrenta al diseñar y desarrollar aplicaciones empresariales? ¿Cómo construyes el extremo trasero para que no sólo se ocupe de tus necesidades actuales sino que sea lo suficientemente flexible para que tu sistema pueda evolucionar a medida que se expandan tus necesidades? Responde estas preguntas y muchas más con Building Java Enterprise Applications, una guía avanzada para construir aplicaciones complejas Java Enterprise desde el suelo que aborda cuestiones de diseño en el camino. Estos libros prácticos dan un paso atrás del examen detallado de las API y se centran en toda la imagen, por lo que puede armar las piezas y construir algo que funcione! Este libro explora las cuestiones de infraestructura tan importantes para el buen diseño de aplicaciones. No es sólo un libro sobre hacer cosas con los frijoles de la Entidad, JDBC y JMS y JNDI. Le lleva paso a paso a través de la construcción del extremo posterior, diseñando la tienda de datos para que le dé acceso conveniente a los datos que su aplicación necesita; diseñar un directorio; averiguar cómo manejar la seguridad y dónde almacenar las credenciales de seguridad que necesita; y así sucesivamente. Además, muestra, lo más fácil posible, cómo construir la capa de frijol de la entidad que pone la información a disposición del resto de la aplicación. A lo largo de esta guía, el autor Brett McLaughlin utiliza su riqueza de experiencia en el mundo real con el desarrollo de la empresa para mostrarle un paso a la vez cómo diseñar y construir una aplicación integral de la empresa desde el suelo, empezando por el extremo posterior.

title: Building Isomorphic JavaScript Apps
description:
Isomorphic JavaScript, often described as the holy grail of web application development, refers to running JavaScript code on both the browser client and web application server. This application architecture has become increasingly popular for the benefits of SEO, optimized page load and full control of the UI, and isomorphic libraries are being used at companies like Walmart, Airbnb, Facebook, and Netflix.

With this practical book, authors Jason Strimpel and Maxime Najim provide the knowledge you need to build and maintain your own isomorphic JavaScript apps.

This book includes:

Part 1 identifies different classifications of isomorphic JavaScript apps, and shows you how to set up a development environment
Part 2 takes you from theory to practice by showing you how to build out your own isomorphic app
Part 3 takes you through existing solutions in the market today, providing you with the knowledge you need to bring isomorphic solutions into your development workflow

Use browser debugging tools and troubleshooting techniques
Understand event handling, form events, and JavaScript applications with forms

You'll gain valuable insights into turning your tech passion into a career and how developer advocates maintain authenticity and influence change in technologies like Java, AI, and the cloud.

Master balancing company needs with community engagement for impact.

title: Reactive Programming with RxJS
description:
Reactive programming is revolutionary. It makes asynchronous programming cleaner, intuitive, and robust. Discover how to use the RxJS library to write programs in a simpler way, unifying asynchronous mechanisms such as callbacks and promises into a single, powerful construct. Learn to think about your programs as streams of data that you can transform by expressing what should happen, instead of having to painstakingly program how it should happen. You'll be able to handle real-world concurrency and write complex flows of events in your applications with ease.

Create highly concurrent applications while writing simpler code using the Reactive Extensions for JavaScript (RxJS), a set of libraries for event composition. Programming real-world applications in JavaScript involves lots of asynchronous events--you might end up spending more time coordinating asynchronous code in your program than writing its actual functionality. This book introduces concepts and tools from reactive programming that will help you write cleaner and more robust asynchronous programs.

Find out about Observable sequences, a unifying data type to write highly concurrent code. Discover Schedulers and change the concept of time in your applications, making asynchronous testing sane again. Along the way you'll see real-world examples for the browser and Node.js, including a real-time earthquake visualization in 20 lines of code and a frantic shoot-'em-up space videogame. You'll also use Cycle.js - a modern, fully reactive web framework - to make a whole new breed of web applications.

By the end of the book, you'll know how to apply reactive programming to solve complex problems, build efficient programs with reactive user interfaces, and write your code more declaratively.

What You Need:

A modern web browser, Node.JS installed in your computer, and the RxJS JavaScript library.

title: Vue.js Quick Start Guide
description:

You will learn foundational concepts such as components, directives, and state management while also exploring advanced features like Vuex, Nuxt, and custom plugins to enhance your apps.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the fundamental concepts of Vue.js, such as components, templates, and directives.
Build scalable and reusable front-end features using slots and components in Vue.
Enhance your applications with animations and transitions using Vue's features.
Integrate state management into your applications with Vuex for centralized state control.
Streamline development of Vue applications using Nuxt.js and server-side rendering (SSR).

None Imsirovic is a software developer with extensive experience in front-end development, specializing in Vue.js. Passionate about teaching, None has authored this book to provide learners with a hands-on and practical approach to rapidly gain proficiency with Vue.js.

If you're aiming to understand Vue.js and utilize it to create sophisticated web applications, this book suits your needs perfectly.

title: Continuous Enterprise Development in Java
description:
Learn a use-case approach for developing Java enterprise applications in a continuously test-driven fashion. With this hands-on guide, authors and JBoss project leaders Andrew Lee Rubinger and Aslak Knutsen show you how to build high-level components, from persistent storage to the user interface, using the Arquillian testing platform and several other JBoss projects and tools.

Through the course of the book, you’ll build a production-ready software conference tracker called GeekSeek, using source code from GitHub. Rubinger and Knutsen demonstrate why testing is the very foundation of development—essential for ensuring that code is consumable, complete, and correct.

Bootstrap an elementary Java EE project from start to finish before diving into the full-example application, GeekSeek
Use both relational and NoSQL storage models to build and test GeekSeek’s data persistence layers
Tackle testable business logic development and asynchronous messaging with an SMTP service
Expose enterprise services as a RESTful interface, using Java EE’s JAX-RS framework
Implement OAuth authentication with JBoss’s PicketLink identity management service
Validate the UI by automating interaction in the browser and reading the rendered page
Perform full-scale integration testing on the final deployable archive

Con esta guía práctica, los autores y los líderes del proyecto JBoss Andrew Lee Rubinger y Aslak Knutsen le muestran cómo construir componentes de alto nivel, desde el almacenamiento persistente hasta la interfaz de usuario, utilizando la plataforma de pruebas Arquillian y varios otros proyectos y herramientas JBoss.

A través del curso del libro, usted construirá un rastreador de conferencias de software listo para la producción llamado GeekSeek, utilizando el código fuente de GitHub. Rubinger y Knutsen demuestran por qué la prueba es la base misma del desarrollo —esencial para asegurar que el código sea consumible, completo y correcto.

Ejecute un proyecto Java EE elemental desde el principio hasta el final antes de bucear en la aplicación de salida completa, GeekSeek
Utilice modelos de almacenamiento relacionales y NoSQL para crear y probar las capas de persistencia de datos de GeekSeek
Tackle testable desarrollo de lógica empresarial y mensajería asincrónica con un servicio SMTP
Expose servicios empresariales como una interfaz RESTful, utilizando el marco JAX-RS de Java EE
Implementar autenticación OAuth con el servicio de gestión de identidad de PicketLink de JBoss
Validar la interfaz de usuario automatizando la interacción en el navegador y leyendo la página renderizada
Realizar pruebas de integración a gran escala en el archivo final implementable

title: Java Data Objects
description:
Java Data Objects revolutionizes the way Java developers interact with databases and other datastores. JDO allows you to store and retrieve objects in a way that's natural to Java programmers. Instead of working with JDBC or EJB's container-managed persistence, you work directly with your Java objects. You don't have to copy data to and from database tables or issue SELECTs to perform queries: your JDO implementation takes care of persistence behind-the-scenes, and you make queries based on the fields of your Java objects, using normal Java syntax.

The result is software that is truly object-oriented: not code that is partially object-oriented, with a large database-shaped lump on the back end. JDO lets you save plain, ordinary Java objects, and does not force you to use different data models and types for dealing with storage. As a result, your code becomes easier to maintain, easier to re-use, and easier to test. And you're not tied to a specific database vendor: your JDO code is entirely database-independent. You don't even need to know whether the datastore is a relational database, an object database, or just a set of files.

This book, written by the JDO Specification Lead and one of the key contributors to the JDO Specification, is the definitive work on the JDO API. It gives you a thorough introduction to JDO, starting with a simple application that demonstrates many of JDO's capabilities. It shows you how to make classes persistent, how JDO maps persistent classes to the database, how to configure JDO at runtime, how to perform transactions, and how to make queries. More advanced chapters cover optional features such as nontransactional access and optimistic transactions. The book concludes by discussing the use of JDO in web applications and J2EE environments.

Whether you only want to read up on an interesting new technology, or are seriously considering an alternative to JDBC or EJB CMP, you'll find that this book is essential. It provides by far the most authoritative and complete coverage available.

Usted no tiene que copiar datos a y desde tablas de bases de datos o emitir SELECTs para realizar consultas: su implementación JDO se ocupa de la persistencia detrás de los escenarios, y usted hace consultas basadas en los campos de sus objetos Java, utilizando la sintaxis Java normal.

Y usted no está vinculado a un proveedor específico de bases de datos: su código JDO es totalmente independiente de la base de datos. Ni siquiera necesita saber si la tienda de datos es una base de datos relacional, una base de datos de objetos o simplemente un conjunto de archivos.

Este libro, escrito por JDO Specification Lead y uno de los principales contribuyentes a la especificación JDO, es el trabajo definitivo en la API JDO. Le da una introducción completa a JDO, comenzando con una aplicación simple que demuestra muchas de las capacidades de JDO. Le muestra cómo hacer que las clases sean persistentes, cómo JDO mapea las clases persistentes a la base de datos, cómo configurar JDO en tiempo de ejecución, cómo realizar transacciones y cómo hacer consultas. Los capítulos más avanzados abarcan características opcionales como el acceso no transaccional y las transacciones optimistas. El libro concluye discutiendo el uso de JDO en aplicaciones web y entornos J2EE.

title: JavaServer Pages Pocket Reference

The reason for this is simple: JSP capitalizes on the power of Java servlets to create effective, reusable web applications.JSP allows you to develop robust, powerful web content, and the best part is that you're not required to be a hard-core Java programmer.JavaServer Pages Pocket Reference is the perfect companion volume to O'Reilly's best-selling JavaServer Pages, also by Hans Bergsten. This book provides detailed coverage of JSP syntax and processing, directive elements, standard action elements, scripting elements, implicit objects, custom actions, tag library description creation, and WARs.

title: Securing Ajax Applications
description:
Ajax applications should be open yet secure. Far too often security is added as an afterthought. Potential flaws need to be identified and addressed right away. This book explores Ajax and web application security with an eye for dangerous gaps and offers ways that you can plug them before they become a problem. By making security part of the process from the start, you will learn how to build secure Ajax applications and discover how to respond quickly when attacks occur.Securing Ajax Applications succinctly explains that the same back-and-forth communications that make Ajax so responsive also gives invaders new opportunities to gather data, make creative new requests of your server, and interfere with the communications between you and your customers. This book presents basic security techniques and examines vulnerabilities with JavaScript, XML, JSON, Flash, and other technologies -- vital information that will ultimately save you time and money.Topics include:

An overview of the evolving web platform, including APIs, feeds, web services and asynchronous messaging
Web security basics, including common vulnerabilities, common cures, state management and session management
How to secure web technologies, such as Ajax, JavaScript, Java applets, Active X controls, plug-ins, Flash and Flex
How to protect your server, including front-line defense, dealing with application servers, PHP and scripting
Vulnerabilities among web standards such as HTTP, XML, JSON, RSS, ATOM, REST, and XDOS
How to secure web services, build secure APIs, and make open mashups secure
Securing Ajax Applications takes on the challenges created by this new generation of web development, and demonstrates why web security isn't just for administrators and back-end programmers any more. It's also for web developers who accept the responsibility that comes with using the new wonders of the Web.
translatedDescription:
Las aplicaciones de Ajax deben estar abiertas pero seguras. Demasiado a menudo la seguridad se añade como un pensamiento posterior. Los posibles defectos deben identificarse y abordarse inmediatamente. Este libro explora Ajax y seguridad de la aplicación web con un ojo para lagunas peligrosas y ofrece formas de conectarlas antes de que se conviertan en un problema. Al hacer parte de seguridad del proceso desde el principio, usted aprenderá a construir aplicaciones seguras de Ajax y descubrir cómo responder rápidamente cuando se producen ataques. Asegurar aplicaciones de Ajax explica de forma sucinta que las mismas comunicaciones que hacen que Ajax sea tan sensible también da a los invasores nuevas oportunidades para reunir datos, hacer nuevas solicitudes creativas de su servidor, e interferir con las comunicaciones entre usted y sus clientes. Este libro presenta técnicas básicas de seguridad y examina vulnerabilidades con JavaScript, XML, JSON, Flash y otras tecnologías, información vital que finalmente le ahorrará tiempo y dinero. Los temas incluyen:

Una visión general de la plataforma web en evolución, incluyendo API, feeds, servicios web y mensajería asincrónica
Bases de seguridad web, incluyendo vulnerabilidades comunes, curas comunes, gestión estatal y gestión de sesiones
Cómo asegurar las tecnologías web, como Ajax, JavaScript, applets Java, controles Active X, plug-ins, Flash y Flex
Cómo proteger su servidor, incluyendo defensa de primera línea, tratando con servidores de aplicaciones, PHP y scripting
Vulnerabilidades entre estándares web como HTTP, XML, JSON, RSS, ATOM, REST y XDOS
Cómo asegurar servicios web, construir APIs seguras y hacer mashups abiertos seguros
Garantizar aplicaciones de Ajax toma los retos creados por esta nueva generación de desarrollo web, y demuestra por qué la seguridad web ya no es sólo para administradores y programadores de back-end. Es también para los desarrolladores web que aceptan la responsabilidad que viene con el uso de las nuevas maravillas de la Web.

title: Hands-On Cloud Development with WildFly
description:
"Hands-On Cloud Development with WildFly" guides you through building, deploying, and managing cloud-based enterprise Java applications using technologies like WildFly Swarm and OpenShift. This practical guide covers everything from microservices creation to cloud deployment and production-grade readiness, equipping you with skills to build and deploy scalable, reliable applications.

What this Book will help me do

Master the usage of WildFly Swarm to create and optimize Java-based microservices.
Implement cloud deployments and container orchestration with OpenShift.
Utilize Jenkins for implementing CI/CD pipelines to automate your application lifecycle.
Secure enterprise applications using advanced technologies such as Keycloak.
Enhance application resilience and performance by integrating Hystrix.

Author(s)

Tomasz Adamski is a seasoned software developer and architect with vast experience in Java and cloud applications. He has spent years designing and implementing enterprise Java systems, making him an authority on this subject. Tomasz's educational and approachable teaching style makes learning complex topics engaging and actionable.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for experienced Java developers aiming to extend their expertise into cloud-based development. Whether you're familiar with basic Java EE applications or seeking to harness the cloud's full potential for enterprise-grade systems, this step-by-step guide will meet your needs. It is particularly tailored for professionals interested in using WildFly Swarm and OpenShift for microservices in the cloud.

Esta guía práctica cubre todo desde la creación de microservicios hasta el despliegue en la nube y la preparación en grado de producción, dotándolo de habilidades para construir y desplegar aplicaciones escalables y fiables.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Domine el uso de WildFly Swarm para crear y optimizar microservicios basados en Java.
Implementar despliegues de nubes y orquestación de contenedores con OpenShift.
Utilizar Jenkins para implementar tuberías CI/CD para automatizar su ciclo de vida de aplicación.
Aplicaciones empresariales seguras utilizando tecnologías avanzadas como Keycloak.
Mejorar la resiliencia y el rendimiento de la aplicación mediante la integración de Hystrix.

Autor(s)

Tomasz Adamski es un desarrollador de software experimentado y arquitecto con vasta experiencia en aplicaciones Java y cloud. Ha pasado años diseñando e implementando sistemas empresariales Java, haciéndole una autoridad sobre este tema. El estilo educativo y accesible de Tomasz hace que el aprendizaje de temas complejos sea atractivo y factible.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para desarrolladores Java experimentados que buscan ampliar su experiencia en desarrollo basado en la nube. Ya sea que esté familiarizado con aplicaciones básicas de Java EE o que trate de aprovechar todo el potencial de la nube para sistemas de grado empresarial, esta guía paso a paso cubrirá sus necesidades. Está especialmente adaptado para profesionales interesados en utilizar WildFly Swarm y OpenShift para microservicios en la nube.

title: Learning from jQuery
description:
If you’re comfortable with jQuery but a bit shaky with JavaScript, this concise guide will help you expand your knowledge of the language—especially the code that jQuery covers up for you. Many jQuery devotees write as little code as possible, but with some JavaScript under your belt, you can prevent errors, reduce overhead, and make your application code more efficient.

This book explores event handling, prototypes, and working with the DOM and AJAX through examples and lots of code. You’ll learn common conventions and patterns in JavaScript and—if you’ve never coded with JavaScript before—a tutorial will take you through the basics.

Enhance your jQuery code by using object constructors and prototypes
Reduce overhead and gain more control by handling events with JavaScript
Work with the DOM much faster with JavaScript than you can with jQuery
Send a few AJAX requests without having to load the entire jQuery library
Understand the importance of JavaScript code standards, comments, code reuse, and anti-patterns
Enlist JavaScript resources, such as a good IDE, a syntax checker, and version control

Muchos devotos jQuery escriben lo más mínimo posible, pero con algunos JavaScript bajo tu cinturón, puedes evitar errores, reducir la sobrecarga y hacer que tu código de aplicación sea más eficiente.

Este libro explora el manejo de eventos, prototipos y trabajar con el DOM y AJAX a través de ejemplos y un montón de código. Aprenderás convenciones y patrones comunes en JavaScript y —si nunca has codificado con JavaScript antes— un tutorial te llevará a través de lo básico.

Mejora tu código jQuery utilizando constructores de objetos y prototipos
Reduzca la sobrecarga y obtenga más control manejando eventos con JavaScript
Trabaja con el DOM mucho más rápido con JavaScript de lo que puedas con jQuery
Enviar algunas peticiones AJAX sin tener que cargar toda la biblioteca jQuery
Comprender la importancia de los estándares de código JavaScript, comentarios, reutilización de códigos y antipatrones
Inscribir recursos JavaScript, como un buen IDE, una verificación de sintaxis y control de versiones

title: Getting Started with Roo
description:
Spring Roo goes a step beyond the Spring Framework by bringing true Rapid Application Development to Java—just as Grails has done with Groovy. This concise introduction shows you how to build applications with Roo, using the framework's shell as an intelligent and timesaving code-completion tool. It's an ideal RAD tool because Roo does much of the tedious code maintenance.

You'll get started by building a simple customer relationship management application, complete with step-by-step instructions and code examples. Learn how to control any part of the application with Roo's opt-in feature, while using this open source framework to automate the rest of the code.

Set up a Spring application and working Maven build to see Roo in action
Address persistence with JPA and the Neo4j graph database—and learn how Roo supports NoSQL databases
Use Roo’s database reverse-engineering feature to generate a data model from an existing schema
Build Roo applications with Spring MVC, Spring WebFlow, Google Web Toolkit, Vaadin, and other web frameworks
Secure and test your application

Esta introducción concisa le muestra cómo construir aplicaciones con Roo, utilizando la cáscara del marco como una herramienta inteligente y de tiempos para completar código. Es una herramienta ideal de RAD porque Roo hace gran parte del mantenimiento de códigos tediosos.

Comenzarás construyendo una sencilla aplicación de gestión de relaciones con los clientes, completa con instrucciones paso a paso y ejemplos de código. Aprende a controlar cualquier parte de la aplicación con la función opt-in de Roo, mientras utiliza este marco de código abierto para automatizar el resto del código.

Establecer una aplicación de primavera y trabajar Maven construir para ver Roo en acción
Aborde la persistencia con JPA y la base de datos de gráficos Neo4j y aprenda cómo soporta Roo bases de datos NoSQL
Utilice la función de ingeniería inversa de la base de datos de Roo para generar un modelo de datos de un esquema existente
Construir aplicaciones Roo con Spring MVC, Spring WebFlow, Google Web Toolkit, Vaadin y otros marcos web
Asegurar y probar su aplicación

title: Java Web Services: Up and Running
description:
This example-driven book offers a thorough introduction to Java's APIs for XML Web Services (JAX-WS) and RESTful Web Services (JAX-RS). Java Web Services: Up and Running takes a clear, pragmatic approach to these technologies by providing a mix of architectural overview, complete working code examples, and short yet precise instructions for compiling, deploying, and executing an application. You'll learn how to write web services from scratch and integrate existing services into your Java applications. With Java Web Services: Up and Running, you will:

Understand the distinction between SOAP-based and REST-style services
Write, deploy, and consume SOAP-based services in core Java
Understand the Web Service Definition Language (WSDL) service contract
Recognize the structure of a SOAP message
Learn how to deliver Java-based RESTful web services and consume commercial RESTful services
Know security requirements for SOAP- and REST-based web services
Learn how to implement JAX-WS in various application servers

Ideal for students as well as experienced programmers, Java Web Services: Up and Running is the concise guide you need to start working with these technologies right away.
translatedDescription:

Java Web Services: Up and Running toma un enfoque claro y pragmático de estas tecnologías proporcionando una mezcla de visión arquitectónica, ejemplos completos de código de trabajo y instrucciones cortas pero precisas para compilar, desplegar y ejecutar una aplicación. Aprenderás a escribir servicios web desde cero e integrar los servicios existentes en tus aplicaciones Java. Con Java Web Services: Up and Running, usted:

Comprender la distinción entre servicios basados en SOAP y estilo REST
Escribir, desplegar y consumir servicios basados en SOAP en Java núcleo
Entender el contrato de servicio de Definición de Idioma de Servicio Web (WSDL)
Reconocer la estructura de un mensaje SOAP
Aprender a ofrecer servicios web RESTful basados en Java y consumir servicios comerciales RESTful
Conoce los requisitos de seguridad para servicios web basados en SOAP y REST
Aprende cómo implementar JAX-WS en varios servidores de aplicaciones

Ideal para estudiantes y programadores experimentados, Java Web Services: Up and Running es la guía concisa que necesitas para empezar a trabajar con estas tecnologías de inmediato.

title: Beginning React
description:
"Beginning React" introduces you to the foundational knowledge and skills needed to develop responsive and dynamic user interfaces with React. By exploring key topics such as component creation, state management, and routing, you'll be equipped to tackle real-world projects effectively.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the essentials of React and its role in web application development.
Learn to break down user interfaces into reusable components.
Master techniques to manage state across applications for intuitive user experiences.
Get hands-on with creating and handling dynamic user interactions within React components.
Explore routing and navigation for crafting seamless single-page applications.

Author(s)

The authors of "Beginning React" are experienced software engineers and educators, specializing in front-end development with years of working with React technologies. They are passionate about making complex topics accessible to learners and have written this book to provide practical insights and hands-on exercises to make learning React both enjoyable and effective.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for front-end developers eager to enhance their skills by learning React. It assumes a foundational understanding of JavaScript (including ES2015 features), HTML, and CSS. Whether you're aiming to advance in your career or take on a personal project, this book will provide you with the tools needed to build dynamic and responsive web applications.

Al explorar temas clave como la creación de componentes, la gestión estatal y el enrutamiento, usted estará equipado para abordar proyectos del mundo real con eficacia.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprender los elementos esenciales de React y su papel en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web.
Aprende a descomponer las interfaces de usuario en componentes reutilizables.
Técnicas maestras para gestionar el estado a través de aplicaciones para experiencias de usuario intuitivas.
Obtenga manos a mano con la creación y manejo de interacciones dinámicas de usuario dentro de los componentes React.
Explore el enrutamiento y la navegación para la elaboración de aplicaciones de una sola página sin costura.

Autor(s)

Los autores de "Beginning React" son experimentados ingenieros de software y educadores, especializados en desarrollo de vanguardia con años de trabajo con tecnologías React. Son apasionados por hacer que los temas complejos sean accesibles para los estudiantes y han escrito este libro para proporcionar ideas prácticas y ejercicios prácticos para hacer el aprendizaje Reactúe tanto agradable como eficaz.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para los desarrolladores de vanguardia deseosos de mejorar sus habilidades aprendiendo React. Supone una comprensión fundamental de JavaScript (incluyendo las características ES2015), HTML y CSS. Ya sea que esté intentando avanzar en su carrera o realizar un proyecto personal, este libro le proporcionará las herramientas necesarias para construir aplicaciones web dinámicas y receptivas.

title: Ajax on Rails
description:
Learn to build dynamic, interactive web applications using the two most important approaches to web development today: Ajax and the phenomenally efficient Ruby on Rails platform. This book teaches intermediate to advanced web developers how to use both Ajax and Rails to quickly build high-performance, scalable applications without being overwhelmed with thousands of lines of JavaScript code. More than just recipes, you also get a thorough, low-level understanding of what's happening under the hood.

Ajax on Rails includes three fully worked out Rails/Ajax applications, and quick reference sections for Prototype and script.aculo.us.
Testing lessons show you how to eliminate cross-browser JavaScript errors and DOM debugging nightmares using a combination of Firebug, and Venkman.
Advanced material explains the most current design practices for Ajax usability. You'll learn to avoid user experience mistakes with proven design patterns.
Beyond the how-to, Ajax on Rails helps you consider when Ajax is (and isn't) appropriate, and the trade-offs associated with it. For those new to Rails, this book provides a quick introduction, the big picture, a walk through the installation process, and some tips on getting started. If you've already started working with Rails and seek to deepen your skill set, you'll find dozens of examples drawn from real-world projects, exhaustive reference for every relevant feature, and expert advice on how to "Ajaxify" your applications.
translatedDescription:
Aprende a construir aplicaciones web dinámicas e interactivas utilizando los dos enfoques más importantes para el desarrollo web hoy: Ajax y el increíblemente eficiente Ruby en la plataforma Rails. Este libro enseña a desarrolladores web intermedios a avanzados cómo utilizar tanto Ajax como Rails para construir rápidamente aplicaciones escalables de alto rendimiento sin ser abrumados con miles de líneas de código JavaScript. Más que recetas, también tienes una comprensión exhaustiva y de bajo nivel de lo que está pasando bajo la capucha.

Ajax on Rails incluye tres aplicaciones Rails/Ajax completamente elaboradas, y secciones de referencia rápida para Prototype y script.aculo.us.
Las lecciones de prueba le muestran cómo eliminar errores de JavaScript cruzados y DOM depurando pesadillas usando una combinación de Firebug y Venkman.
El material avanzado explica las prácticas de diseño más actuales para la usabilidad de Ajax. Aprenderás a evitar errores de experiencia de usuario con patrones de diseño comprobados.
Más allá de cómo, Ajax on Rails le ayuda a considerar cuando Ajax es (y no es) apropiado, y los intercambios asociados con él. Para los nuevos en Rails, este libro proporciona una introducción rápida, la gran imagen, un paseo por el proceso de instalación, y algunos consejos para empezar. Si ya has empezado a trabajar con Rails y buscas profundizar tu habilidad, encontrarás docenas de ejemplos extraídos de proyectos del mundo real, referencia exhaustiva para todas las características relevantes, y asesoramiento experto sobre cómo "Ajaxificar" tus aplicaciones.

title: Real-Time Java™ Platform Programming
description:
Build powerful real-time Java platform applications.

The authoritative reference to the Real-Time Specification for Java (RTSJ)—by one of its creators

Complete introduction to Java-based RT development—no real-time experience necessary

Covers scheduling, asynchronous transfer control, timers, non-heap memory, garbage collection, performance tradeoffs, program structure, and more

Written for experienced Java platform developers, this practical guide provides a solid grounding in real-time programming. Dibble, a member of the RTSJ expert group, starts with an overview of real-time issues unique to the Java platform. He then explains how to use each major feature of the RTSJ.

From broad real-time principles to detailed programming pitfalls, Real-Time Java Platform Programming covers everything you need to know to build effective RT programs. Key topics include:

Interoperability with non-RT code, tradeoffs in real-time development, and RT issues for the JVMtm software

Garbage collection, non-heap access, physical and "immortal" memory, and constant-time allocation of non-heap memory

Priority scheduling, deadline scheduling, and rate monotonic analysis

Closures, asynchronous transfer of control, asynchronous events, and timers

State-of-the-art information for RT developers:

Threads scheduling

Real-time scheduling

Raw memory access

Performance tradeoffs

Recommended practices

Implementation hints

Dozens of code examples and step-by-step walk-throughs
translatedDescription:
Construir aplicaciones de plataforma Java en tiempo real.

La referencia autorizada a la especificación en tiempo real para Java (RTSJ) por uno de sus creadores

Introducción completa al desarrollo de RT basado en Java – ninguna experiencia en tiempo real necesaria

Cubiertas de programación, control de transferencia asincrónico, temporizadores, memoria no de salto, colección de basura, tradeoffs de rendimiento, estructura del programa, y más

Escrito para desarrolladores experimentados de plataforma Java, esta guía práctica proporciona una sólida base en programación en tiempo real. Dibble, miembro del grupo de expertos de RTSJ, comienza con una visión general de los temas en tiempo real únicos en la plataforma Java. Luego explica cómo utilizar cada característica principal del RTSJ.

Desde principios amplios en tiempo real hasta déficits de programación detallados, Programación de Plataforma Java en tiempo real cubre todo lo que necesitas saber para construir programas RT eficaces. Los temas clave incluyen:

Interoperabilidad con código no TR, intercambios en el desarrollo en tiempo real y problemas RT para el software JVMtm

Recopilación de basura, acceso sin saltos, memoria física e "inmortal", y asignación de tiempo constante de memoria sin salto

Programación de prioridades, programación de plazos y análisis monotónico de tarifas

Cierre, transferencia asincrónica de control, eventos asincrónicos y temporizadores

Información de vanguardia para los desarrolladores de RT:

Pistas de programación

Programación en tiempo real

Acceso a la memoria cruda

Desempeño

Prácticas recomendadas

Indicios de aplicación

Docenas de ejemplos de código y paso a paso

title: Java Message Service (JMS) for J2EE
description:
The authoritative guide to JMS for enterprise developers. JMS API is gaining important popularity for Enterprise applications and there is no adequate documentation for JMS for the J2EE platform. This book covers not only the concepts, but also present simple examples to explain the concepts and real sample applications to show how to use those concepts and techniques.

J2EE is commonly used for enterprise applications. The Java(tm) Message Service (JMS) API has been developed by Sun working in close cooperation with the leading enterprise messaging vendors. Enterprise messaging is now recognized as an essential tool for building enterprise applications. By combining Java technology with enterprise messaging, the JMS API provides a new, powerful tool for solving enterprise computing problems. Enterprise messaging provides a reliable, flexible service for the asynchronous exchange of critical business data and events throughout an enterprise. The JMS API adds to this a common API and provider framework that enables the development of portable, message based applications in the Java programming language.
translatedDescription:
The authoritative guide to JMS for enterprise developers. JMS API está ganando popularidad importante para aplicaciones Enterprise y no hay documentación adecuada para JMS para la plataforma J2EE. Este libro abarca no sólo los conceptos, sino que también presenta ejemplos simples para explicar los conceptos y las aplicaciones de muestras reales para mostrar cómo utilizar esos conceptos y técnicas.

J2EE es comúnmente utilizado para aplicaciones empresariales. La API Java(tm) Message Service (JMS) ha sido desarrollada por Sun trabajando en estrecha cooperación con los principales proveedores de mensajería empresarial. La mensajería empresarial se reconoce ahora como una herramienta esencial para la construcción de aplicaciones empresariales. Al combinar la tecnología Java con la mensajería empresarial, el JMS API proporciona una nueva herramienta potente para resolver problemas de computación empresarial. La mensajería empresarial proporciona un servicio fiable y flexible para el intercambio asincrónico de datos y eventos empresariales críticos en toda una empresa. El JMS API añade a esto un marco común de API y proveedores que permite el desarrollo de aplicaciones portátiles basadas en mensajes en el lenguaje de programación Java.

title: The Java EE 6 Tutorial: Advanced Topics, Fourth Edition
description:
The Java EE 6 Tutorial: Advanced Topics, Fourth Edition, is a task-oriented, example-driven guide to developing enterprise applications for the Java Platform, Enterprise Edition 6 (Java EE 6). Written by members of the Java EE 6 documentation team at Oracle, this book provides new and intermediate Java programmers with a deep understanding of the platform.

This guide–which builds on the concepts introduced in The Java EE 6 Tutorial: Basic Concepts, Fourth Edition–contains advanced material, including detailed introductions to more complex platform features and instructions for using the latest version of the NetBeans IDE and the GlassFish Server, Open Source Edition.

This book introduces the Java Message Service (JMS) API and Java EE Interceptors. It also describes advanced features of JavaServer Faces, Servlets, JAX-RS, Enterprise¿ JavaBeans components, the Java Persistence API, Contexts and Dependency Injection for the Java EE Platform, web and enterprise application security, and Bean Validation. The book culminates with three new case studies that illustrate the use of multiple Java EE 6 APIs.

Escrito por miembros del equipo de documentación Java EE 6 en Oracle, este libro proporciona a los programadores Java nuevos e intermedios una comprensión profunda de la plataforma.

Esta guía –que se basa en los conceptos introducidos en el Tutorial Java EE 6: Conceptos básicos, cuarta edición– contiene material avanzado, incluyendo presentaciones detalladas a características de plataforma más complejas e instrucciones para utilizar la última versión del IDE de NetBeans y el Servidor de GlassFish, Open Source Edition.

Este libro presenta el Java Message Service (JMS) API y los Interceptores Java EE. También describe características avanzadas de JavaServer Faces, Servlets, JAX-RS, componentes de JavaBeans, API de Persistencia de Java, Contextos e Inyección de Dependencia para la Plataforma EE de Java, seguridad de aplicaciones web y empresariales, y Validación de Bean. El libro culmina con tres nuevos estudios de casos que ilustran el uso de múltiples API Java EE 6.

title: Lo-Dash Essentials
description:
"Lo-Dash Essentials" demystifies Lo-Dash, a powerful JavaScript library for handling data manipulation efficiently. In this book, you will learn how to leverage Lo-Dash to write optimized, clean, and manageable code, unlocking new possibilities in your JavaScript projects.

What this Book will help me do

Write robust JavaScript code by mastering Lo-Dash's array and object manipulation utilities.
Create high-performance applications using Lo-Dash's functional programming patterns.
Craft efficient data transformation pipelines with map, reduce, and filter techniques.
Gain insight into comparing Lo-Dash with other libraries to make informed choices based on project needs.
Understand Lo-Dash's internal workings to create optimized and maintainable JavaScript solutions.

Author(s)

Adam Boduch is a software engineer with extensive experience in JavaScript and a passion for creating efficient, clean, and reusable code. He approaches technical explanation in a lucid and engaging manner, blending examples with theory to illuminate the practicality of programming concepts.

Who is it for?

This book is tailored for JavaScript developers who are keen on improving their proficiency in using libraries for data manipulation. Whether you're new to Lo-Dash or seeking to go deeper into its usage, this resource offers clear and actionable knowledge. If you're desiring to write concise and optimized code while enhancing readability and maintainability, this book will match your ambitions.

title: YUI 3 Cookbook
description: Solve a wide range of problems in your web application quickly and efficiently with the Yahoo! User Interface Library (YUI). With this definitive, getting-started guide to version 3 of the popular open source JavaScript library, you’ll learn how to address many of the most common and challenging problems that web development presents.

title: Modern Programming Made Easy: Using Java, Scala, Groovy, and JavaScript
description:
Get up and running fast with the basics of programming using Java as an example language. This short book gets you thinking like a programmer in an easy and entertaining way. Modern Programming Made Easy teaches you basic coding principles, including working with lists, sets, arrays, and maps; coding in the object-oriented style; and writing a web application.

This book is largely language agnostic, but mainly covers the latest appropriate and relevant release of Java, with some updated references to Groovy, Scala, and JavaScript to give you a broad range of examples to consider. You will get a taste of what modern programming has to offer and set yourself up for further study and growth in your chosen language.

 

What You'll Learn

Write code using the functional programming style
Build your code using the latest releases of Java, Groovy, and more
Test your code
Read and write from files
Design user interfaces
Deploy your app in the cloud

 

Who This Book Is For

 Anyone who wants to learn how to code. Whether you're a student, a teacher, looking for a career change, or just a hobbyist, this book is made for you.
translatedDescription:
Levántate y corre rápido con los fundamentos de la programación usando Java como un lenguaje de ejemplo. Este libro corto te hace pensar como un programador de una manera fácil y entretenido. Modern Programming Made Easy le enseña principios básicos de codificación, incluyendo trabajar con listas, conjuntos, arrays y mapas; codificación en el estilo orientado al objeto; y escribir una aplicación web.

Este libro es en gran parte agnóstico del lenguaje, pero cubre principalmente la última versión apropiada y relevante de Java, con algunas referencias actualizadas a Groovy, Scala y JavaScript para darle una amplia gama de ejemplos a considerar. Usted obtendrá un sabor de lo que la programación moderna tiene que ofrecer y establecerse para más estudio y crecimiento en su idioma elegido.

Quién es este libro

Cualquiera que quiera aprender a código. Ya sea estudiante, profesor, buscando un cambio de carrera, o sólo un hobbyista, este libro está hecho para usted.

title: Adding Ajax
description:
Ajax can bring many advantages to an existing web application without forcing you to redo the whole thing. This book explains how you can add Ajax to enhance, rather than replace, the way your application works. For instance, if you have a traditional web application based on submitting a form to update a table, you can enhance it by adding the capability to update the table with changes to the form fields, without actually having to submit the form. That's just one example.Adding Ajax is for those of you more interested in extending existing applications than in creating Rich Internet Applications (RIA). You already know the "business-side" of applications-web forms, server-side driven pages, and static content-and now you want to make your web pages livelier, more fun, and much more interactive. This book:

Provides an overview of Ajax technologies, and the importance of developing a strategy for changing your site before you sit down to code
Explains the heart and soul of Ajax: how to work with the XMLHttpRequest object
Introduces and demonstrates several important Ajax libraries, including Prototype, script.aculo.us, rico, Mochikit
Explores the interactive element that is Ajax, including how to work with events and event handlers that work across browsers
Introduces the concept of web page as space, and covers three popular approaches to managing web space
Explains how to make data updates, including adding new data, deleting, and making updates, all from within a single page
Describes the effects Ajax has on the Web-breaking the back button, losing browser history, dynamic effects that disappear when the page is refreshed, and more
Covers advanced CSS effects, including drag and drop "scroll bars", pagination, and the use of SVG and the Canvas object
Explores mashups-Ajax's ability to combine data from different web services in any number of ways, directly in our web pages
You don't need to start over to use Ajax. You can simply add to what you already have. This book explains how.
translatedDescription:
Ajax puede traer muchas ventajas a una aplicación web existente sin obligarte a rehacer todo el asunto. Este libro explica cómo puede agregar Ajax para mejorar, en lugar de sustituir, la forma en que funciona su aplicación. Por ejemplo, si tiene una aplicación web tradicional basada en enviar un formulario para actualizar una tabla, puede mejorarla añadiendo la capacidad de actualizar la tabla con cambios en los campos de formularios, sin tener que enviar el formulario. Es sólo un ejemplo. Agregar Ajax es para aquellos de ustedes más interesados en ampliar las aplicaciones existentes que en la creación de aplicaciones de Internet Rico (RIA). Ya conoces el "foto de negocios" de las formas de aplicaciones-web, páginas impulsadas por el servidor y contenido estático-y ahora quieres hacer tus páginas web más vivas, más divertidas y mucho más interactivas. Este libro:

Proporciona una visión general de las tecnologías de Ajax, y la importancia de desarrollar una estrategia para cambiar su sitio antes de sentarse a código
Explica el corazón y el alma de Ajax: cómo trabajar con el objeto XMLHtpRequest
Presenta y demuestra varias bibliotecas importantes de Ajax, incluyendo Prototipo, script.aculo.us, rico, Mochikit
Explora el elemento interactivo que es Ajax, incluyendo cómo trabajar con eventos y manipuladores de eventos que trabajan a través de navegadores
Introduce el concepto de página web como espacio, y cubre tres enfoques populares para gestionar el espacio web
Explica cómo hacer actualizaciones de datos, incluyendo añadir nuevos datos, borrar y hacer actualizaciones, todo desde dentro de una sola página
Describe los efectos que Ajax tiene en el Web-breaking el botón de atrás, perdiendo la historia del navegador, efectos dinámicos que desaparecen cuando la página es refrescante, y más
Cubre los efectos avanzados de CSS, incluyendo barras de arrastrar y soltar, paginación, y el uso de SVG y el objeto Canvas
Explora la capacidad de mashups-Ajax para combinar datos de diferentes servicios web de cualquier manera, directamente en nuestras páginas web
No necesitas empezar de nuevo a usar Ajax. Simplemente puedes añadir a lo que ya tienes. Este libro explica cómo.

title: Seam in Action
description:
Seam in Action offers a practical and in-depth look at Seam from outside the walls of RedHat/JBoss. The book puts Seam head-to-head with the complexities in the Java EE architecture. It discusses the shortcomings of JSF, the challenges of using Java persistence in the web environment, and other common development roadblocks, then shows how Seam makes these problems just melt away. In covering Seam, the author doesn't just ask you to sprinkle annotations on your code and expect that you understand how it works. Instead, the author lays down the facts, shows you the steps, reveals the logic, and diagrams the flow, so that by the end of the book, you will not only have gained a deep understanding of Seam, but will also come away ready to teach the material to others.

About the Technology

Seam is an exciting new application framework based on the Java EE platform that you can use to build rich, web-based business applications. Seam is rapidly capturing the interest of Java enterprise developers because of its focus on simplicity, ease of use, transparent integration, scalability, and developer choice.

About the Book

All too often, developers spend a majority of their time integrating disparate technologies, manually tracking state, struggling to understand JSF, wrestling with Hibernate exceptions, and constantly redeploying applications, rather than on the logic pertaining to the business at hand. Seam in Action dives deep into thorough explanations of how Seam eliminates these non-core tasks by leveraging configuration by exception, Java 5 annotations, and aspect-oriented programming.

To start off, you will see a working Java EE-compliant application come together by the end of the second chapter. As you progress through the book, you will discover how Seam eliminates unnecessary layers and configurations and uses an inversion of control technical known as bijection supplemented by a liberal use of the Unified Expression Language (EL) to establish the missing link between JSF, EJB 3 and JavaBean components. You also witness how Seam opens doors for you to incorporate technologies you previously have not had time to learn, such as business processes and stateful page flows (jBPM), rule-based security, Ajax remoting, PDF generation, Spring integration, and more.

What's Inside
Get started with Seam using seam-gen
Clarifies the inner workings of bijection
Breaks down all the Seam annotations
Covers integration with Spring 2.0
Shows how to make your applications rich (and hopefully you too!)
Depth beyond what is found in the reference documentation
About the ReaderAbout the Author

Dan Allen is a passionate enterprise software developer, scholar, and mentor. For Dan, the end game is to be a mentor, and writing is one medium he uses to pursue that goal. Dan has over eight years of development experience using technologies that include Java frameworks (Seam, JSF, EJB3, Hibernate, Spring, Struts), testing frameworks (JUnit, TestNG), JavaScript and DOM scripting, CSS and page layouts, Maven 2, Ant, Groovy, as well as a wealth of other technologies not mentioned. Dan is also a dedicated open source advocate, and is very proud, and not a tad bit shy, about the fact that he has been running Linux, and only Linux, since the turn of the millennium. Dan's professional passions are equally divided between Java and Linux, with a hint of other technologies mixed in.

Galligan, Medical Research ForumEssential!- Ted Goddard, ICEfaces.orgEasy to read, easy to understand - the best way to get going.- Nikolaos Kaintantzisl, Zühlke Engineering
translatedDescription:
Seam in Action ofrece una mirada práctica y profunda a Seam desde fuera de las paredes de RedHat/JBoss. El libro pone a Seam cabeza a cabeza con las complejidades en la arquitectura Java EE. Se analizan las deficiencias de la JSF, los desafíos de utilizar la persistencia de Java en el entorno web, y otros bloqueos comunes de desarrollo, luego muestra cómo Seam hace que estos problemas se derriten. Al cubrir Seam, el autor no le pide que espolvoree anotaciones en su código y espere que entienda cómo funciona. En cambio, el autor pone los hechos, te muestra los pasos, revela la lógica, y diagrama el flujo, de modo que al final del libro, no sólo habrás adquirido una comprensión profunda de Seam, sino que también vendrá listo para enseñar el material a otros.

Acerca de la tecnología

Seam es un nuevo marco de aplicación emocionante basado en la plataforma Java EE que puede utilizar para construir aplicaciones empresariales ricas y basadas en la web. Seam está captando rápidamente el interés de los desarrolladores de empresas Java debido a su enfoque en la simplicidad, facilidad de uso, integración transparente, escalabilidad y elección de desarrolladores.

Acerca del libro

Con demasiada frecuencia, los desarrolladores pasan la mayor parte de su tiempo integrando tecnologías dispares, estado de seguimiento manual, luchando para entender la JSF, lucha con excepciones Hibernate, y constantemente redesplegando aplicaciones, en lugar de en la lógica relativa al negocio a la mano. Seam in Action se sumerge profundamente en explicaciones detalladas de cómo Seam elimina estas tareas no básicas aprovechando la configuración por excepción, anotaciones Java 5 y programación orientada hacia el aspecto.

Para empezar, verás que una aplicación compatible con Java EE se reúne al final del segundo capítulo. A medida que avanzas a través del libro, descubrirás cómo Seam elimina capas y configuraciones innecesarias y utiliza una inversión de control técnico conocido como bijeción complementada por un uso liberal del lenguaje de expresión unificada (EL) para establecer el vínculo que falta entre los componentes de JSF, EJB 3 y JavaBean. Usted también es testigo de cómo Seam abre puertas para que usted incorpore tecnologías que anteriormente no ha tenido tiempo para aprender, tales como procesos de negocio y flujos de página de estado (jBPM), seguridad basada en reglas, remoción de Ajax, generación de PDF, integración de primavera, y más.

Qué hay dentro
Empieza con Seam usando Seam-gen
Aclara el funcionamiento interno de la bijección
Rompe todas las anotaciones de Seam
Cubre la integración con Spring 2.0
Muestra cómo hacer que tus aplicaciones sean ricas (¡y espero que tú también!)
Profundidad más allá de lo que se encuentra en la documentación de referencia

title: Programming Jabber
description:
Jabber is a set of protocols expressed in XML, and an extensible framework that allows people and applications to exchange all sorts of information, from simple text messages to being used to extend the backbone of an enterprise data system. Jabber gives you the power to build applications that have identity, presence, and that can take part in conversations.Programming Jabber offers developers a chance to learn and understand the Jabber technology and protocol from an implementer's point of view. Detailed information of each part of the Jabber protocol is introduced, explained, and discussed in the form of mini-projects, or simple and extended examples. Programming Jabber provides this foundation by:

Showing you how to install and configure the Jabber server
Providing a detailed overview of the server architecture and configuration options
Covering the core Jabber technologies such as XML streams and Jabber identifiers
Referencing all of Jabber's XML namespaces
Examining the client registration and authentication phases
Showing how to deploy your own Jabber-based messaging solutions
Demonstrating how to embed XML-RPC-style call mechanisms into Jabber
Programming Jabber is divided into two parts. The first part serves as an introduction to Jabber; you'll learn about its features, why it's more than an IM system, and how to install and configure a Jabber server of your own. The second part provides detailed information about the Jabber protocol, and a series of practical examples, which can be used to solve everyday problems. The examples, in Perl, Python, and Java, use various Jabber features as a way of illustrating parts of the protocol.Programming Jabber provides the foundation and framework for developers to hit the ground running, and is the essential book on Jabber.

Jabber le da el poder de construir aplicaciones que tengan identidad, presencia y que puedan participar en conversaciones. Programación Jabber ofrece a los desarrolladores la oportunidad de aprender y entender la tecnología y protocolo Jabber desde el punto de vista de un implementador. Proporcionar una descripción detallada de las opciones de arquitectura y configuración del servidor
Cubrir las tecnologías básicas de Jabber, como los flujos XML y los identificadores de Jabber
Referencia de todos los espacios de nombres XML de Jabber
Examinar las fases de registro y autenticación del cliente
Mostrando cómo implementar sus propias soluciones de mensajería basadas en Jabber

Programación Jabber proporciona la base y el marco para los desarrolladores para golpear el terreno corriendo, y es el libro esencial en Jabber.

When you've reached a sticking point and need to get to the answer quickly, the new JavaScript Pocket Reference is the book you'll want close at hand.

title: JavaScript & DHTML Cookbook
description:
On numerous online forums for JavaScript and DHTML, the majority of questions begin with "How do I...?" This new Cookbook provides the answers. After reading thousands of forum threads over the years, author and scripting pioneer Danny Goodman has compiled a list of problems that frequently vex scripters of various experience levels. He has now applied state-of-the-art ECMA and W3C DOM standards and used best practices to create this extensive collection of practical recipes that can bring your web pages to life.The JavaScript & DHTML Cookbook is all about adding value to the content of a web page. The book focuses on practical and sensible applications of scripting, rather than flying images and gratuitous color changes. For every problem Goodman addresses, there's a solution or "recipe"--a focused piece of code that web developers can insert directly into their applications. Yet, rather than just cut-and-paste code, you also get explanations of how and why the code works, so you can learn to adapt the problem-solving techniques to your designs.The recipes range from simple tasks, such as manipulating strings and validating dates in JavaScript, to entire libraries that demonstrate complex tasks, such as cross-browser positioning of HTML elements and sorting tables. This book contains over 150 recipes on the following topics:

Working with interactive forms and style sheets
Presenting user-friendly page navigation
Creating dynamic content
Producing visual effects for stationary content
Positioning HTML elements
Managing browser windows and multiple frames
This book is the ideal companion to O'Reilly's JavaScript: The Definitive Guide and Dynamic HTML: The Definitive Reference. If you own either of these books, the JavaScript & DHTML Cookbook is a must.

title: Values Don’t Change, Even as You Chase Success
description:

Play tough, play hard, play fair: returning to the simple values that made American business great.

Growing up poor in rural Idaho, I was taught to play by the rules. Be tough, be competitive, give the game all you have--but do it fairly. These simple values formed a basis for how families, neighborhoods, and communities behaved. They did not lose their legitimacy when I became a player in business. Yet they are missing in segments of today’s marketplace....

title: The JavaScript Programming Language
description:
The JavaScript Programming Language provides a brief introduction to the JavaScript language that is now an important component of every programmers tool box. It offers an overview of JavaScript to students interested in pursuing advanced programming skills.

Clear and Concise, The JavaScript Programming Language is an excellent primer to this popular dynamic language and is ideal for use on its own or when coupled with one of Jones and Bartlett's outstanding introductory computer science texts.

title: SAMS Teach Yourself Ajax in 10 Minutes
description: Sams Teach Yourself Ajax in 10 Minutes is a concise introduction to the basics of building Ajax applications and the architecture and operation of these applications. You will be able to immediately begin building web applications, and will have platform from which to explore more advanced aspects of Ajax.

title: Introduction to ASP.NET 4 AJAX Client Templates
description: This Wrox Blox will teach you how to create and customize ASP.NET 4 AJAX Preview 4 Client Templates. The author shows you how to use declarative as well as imperative data-binding techniques to address the simple to advanced UI requirements. He also covers how the observer pattern is fully implemented in ASP.NET 4 AJAX and, when used in conjunction with the Client Template markup extensions, provides a developer experience much like XAML-based applications like WPF and Silverlight. This Wrox Blox walks you through how to implement examples that fetch data from ASP.NET Web Forms using Page Methods and ASP.NET MVC controller actions, as well as interfacing directly with ADO.NET Data Services.

También se refiere a la forma en que el patrón de observador se aplica plenamente en la ASP. NET 4 AJAX y, cuando se utiliza junto con las extensiones de la plantilla de cliente, proporciona una experiencia de desarrollador muy similar a las aplicaciones basadas en XAML como WPF y Silverlight. Este Wrox Blox te lleva a través de cómo implementar ejemplos que recogen datos de ASP.NET Web Forms usando Métodos de página y acciones de controlador ASP.NET MVC, así como interfacing directamente con ADO.NET Data Services.

title: Using XForms with Mozilla
description: The XForms technology gives you many advantages over ordinary XHTML forms. The XForms technology separates your form's data and presentation and submits your data as XML. XForms-aware applications can validate your data as you type it and can also submit your data to different servers and even store it in files. This tutorial shows you how to use Mozilla to start working with XForms.
translatedDescription: La tecnología XForms le ofrece muchas ventajas sobre las formas XHTML ordinarias. La tecnología XForms separa los datos y la presentación de su formulario y envía sus datos como XML. Las aplicaciones XForms-aware pueden validar sus datos a medida que lo escriba y también pueden enviar sus datos a diferentes servidores e incluso almacenarlos en archivos. Este tutorial le muestra cómo utilizar Mozilla para comenzar a trabajar con XForms.

From visual effects, special controls, and Ajax made easy, the jQuery Visual QuickStart Guide will teach readers how to make the most of jQuery using the task-based, step-by-step, visual format they love.
